items.title: 策略師樂觀看待美股後市 標普2027年底上攻1萬點
items.title_en: Strategist Optimistic on US Stock Outlook, S&P 500 Could Reach 10,000 by End‑2027
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，儘管黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US)後，科技股再度重挫，市場也因新一輪關稅疑慮及最新一批偏熱的通膨數據而感到不安，但這些因素並未打消一位策略師對美股做出樂觀、大膽預測的信心。
Federated Hermes全球股票投資長Steve Chiavarone表示，他仍認為標普500指數有機會在2027年底達到1萬點，較目前水準高出40%。這項預測比德意志銀行、滙豐，以及長期看多市場的Yardeni Research創辦人Ed Yardeni近期提出的預測更加樂觀。Yardeni和德銀策略師Binky Chadha對標普500指數的目標價均為9,000點。
Chiavarone坦言，有些人可能認為他的目標過於樂觀，但他強調，這並非盲目樂觀。首先，他目前預估標普500指數2027年和2028年的每股盈餘分別為425美元和490美元，與FactSet統計的市場共識預估423.24美元和495.39美元大致相符。
Chiavarone表示，「我的目標之所以看起來荒謬，唯一原因是過去一個月市場本益比已跌至17倍。」他指出，目前股價反映的是2027年經濟將放緩的預期，但他並不認為這種情況會發生。
他談到，「除非你認為經濟即將陷入衰退，否則本益比不應持續遭到壓縮。」他補充，如果標普500指數明年僅以他預估的2028年每股盈餘為基礎，回升至20倍本益比，指數就有機會達到1萬點。
Chiavarone認為，市場對AI支出即將停滯的擔憂被過度放大。事實上，他表示，2027年資本支出略微放緩，未必是壞事。這可能讓未來幾年的支出更具持續性，也有助於降低市場對所謂「循環融資」疑慮。
這也可能帶動AI晶片成本下降。雖然這對輝達、記憶體大廠美光科技(MU-US)、超微(AMD-US)及其他半導體公司而言，未必是好消息，但Chiavarone表示，這可能讓軟體、網路安全公司及其他優質成長股等AI使用者受惠。
他指出，「晶片股交易最好的時光可能已經過去，但我認為這對AI支出者反而是好事。如果資本支出稍微放緩，價格壓力就會減輕。」
那麼，哪些因素可能讓他的預測落空？Chiavarone表示，科技業獲利成長確實可能比預期更大幅放緩，AI企業也可能出現信用問題，進一步打擊市場信心。但他認為這兩種情境發生的可能性都不高，聯準會(Fed)犯下政策錯誤的風險也不大。
Chiavarone認為，聯準會很可能在12月升息，並可能在2027年初再升息兩次。但他表示，考量到今年第一季伊朗戰爭推升油價，之後通膨年增率的比較基期將逐漸變得有利，屆時通膨數據應會開始改善。
他表示，「聯準會可能停止升息。」他補充，這將有助於市場漲勢擴大。小型股、金融股及其他對利率敏感的股票可能因此受惠。Chiavarone也認為，估值偏低的非必需消費品類股相當具吸引力。他並維持原先看法，認為投資人應開始減碼民生必需品、醫療保健及其他防禦型類股。
沒錯，目前市場看起來確實令人不安。近期股市回檔速度相當快，跌幅也十分顯著。但這可能只是典型的恐慌性賣壓。只要看看VIX恐慌指數就能發現，本月稍早還在15至17左右，，如今已飆升至30左右。
Chiavarone表示，「大家需要先冷靜下來。市場上有很多投資人已經開始動搖。多頭市場通常是在一片自負與狂妄中結束，而不是在不確定與疑慮中落幕。」
這番話或許有道理。華爾街也有一句廣為人知的格言：市場總是在憂慮之牆上攀升。投資人如今正仰望著這道高牆，問題在於，究竟需要什麼條件，才能讓他們重新開始向上攀爬。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that despite Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia (NVDA‑US) triggering another tech‑stock pullback, and market unease over a fresh round of tariff concerns and the latest batch of still‑hot inflation data, those factors have not dampened a strategist’s confidence to make an optimistic, bold forecast for US equities.

Federated Hermes global equities chief Steve Chiavarone said he still believes the S&P 500 has a chance to hit 10,000 points by the end of 2027, about 40% above current levels. This outlook is more upbeat than recent forecasts from Deutsche Bank, HSBC and Yardeni Research founder Ed Yardeni, who both target the index at 9,000 points.

Chiavarone admitted some may view his target as overly optimistic, but he stressed it is not blind optimism. He currently estimates S&P 500 earnings per share of $425 for 2027 and $490 for 2028, roughly in line with FactSet’s consensus forecasts of $423.24 and $495.39 respectively.

He explained, “My target looks absurd only because the market P/E ratio has slipped to 17 over the past month.” He noted that today’s prices reflect expectations of a slowing economy in 2027, a scenario he does not believe will materialise.

He added, “Unless you think the economy is about to fall into recession, the P/E ratio should not keep being compressed.” If the index were to rebound to a 20‑times P/E next year based on his 2028 earnings estimate, it could reach the 10,000‑point level.

Chiavarone argued that worries about AI spending stalling are overstated. In fact, a modest slowdown in 2027 capital expenditures may not be a bad thing, as it could make spending more sustainable in the years ahead and ease concerns about so‑called “circular financing.”

That could also drive AI‑chip costs down. While that may not be welcome news for Nvidia, memory giant Micron Technology (MU‑US), AMD (AMD‑US) and other semiconductor firms, Chiavarone said it could benefit software, cybersecurity firms and other high‑growth stocks that use AI.
He noted, “The best trading days for chip stocks may be behind us, but I think that’s actually good for AI spenders. A slight slowdown in capex eases price pressure.”

What could derail his forecast? Chiavarone said tech profit growth could slow more than expected and AI companies might face credit issues, both of which could dent confidence. He believes the likelihood of either scenario is low and that the Fed is unlikely to make a policy mistake.

Chiavarone expects the Fed to raise rates in December and possibly twice more in early 2027. He added that, given the oil‑price spike from the Iran war in Q1, the base for year‑over‑year inflation will become more favorable, allowing inflation data to improve over time.

He said, “The Fed may stop raising rates,” which would help broaden market gains. Small‑caps, financials and other rate‑sensitive stocks could benefit. He also finds undervalued consumer‑discretionary stocks attractive and maintains his view that investors should start trimming exposure to staples, healthcare and other defensive sectors.

Indeed, the market looks uneasy now. Recent pullbacks have been swift and steep, but that may simply be typical panic selling. A glance at the VIX shows it was around 15‑17 earlier this month and has now surged to roughly 30.
Chiavarone warned, “Everyone needs to calm down first. Many investors are already wavering. Bull markets usually end in a wave of hubris and overconfidence, not in uncertainty and doubt.”

That may be true. Wall Street has a well‑known saying: markets always climb the wall of worry. Investors are now staring at that high wall, and the question is what conditions are needed for them to start climbing upward again.

items.title: 〈遠東銀法說〉搶進亞資高雄專區拚明年1月開業 總座示警2027總經變數更多
items.title_en: Far Eastern Bank's Earnings Call: Rushing into Asia Asset Management Kaohsiung Zone for January 2027 Opening, CEO Warns More Economic Variables in 2027
paras: 遠東商銀(2845-TW)今(26)日舉行第三季法說會，總經理林建忠指出，進駐亞資中心高雄專區案預計今年底獲准、明(2027)年1月8日正式開業，將進一步推展高資產與家族辦公室業務。AI 轉型方面，全行 127 項提案中 88 項為 AI 代理，聚焦助員工處理 VASP 告警、客服與授信等任務，今年初至今員工人數自然精簡約七、八十人，並強調須在審慎治理下管理AI代理風險。談及明年總經，林建忠提醒「明年變數比今年大非常多」，應留意美國關稅、升息及AI投資回收。
林建忠表示，遠東銀今年 7 月已取得財富管理 2.0 執照並正式開業，緊接著全力衝刺「亞洲資產管理中心」布局，預計今年底前可獲主管機關核准，並於明(2027)年1月8日在高雄正式開業，結合 2020 年即成立的家族辦公室基礎，搶攻高資產客戶與海外資金回流商機。

在數位轉型與AI應用方面，遠東銀目前全行AI應用提案已累積達127項，其中高達88項(占比69%)已邁入「AI代理(Agent AI)」階段，涵蓋 35 項生成式 AI 與 4 項分析式 AI。林建忠表示，相較於生成式 AI 在金融業仍須高度審慎控管，遠東銀更聚焦讓 Agent AI 協助員工處理實務作業，包括虛擬資產服務商(VASP)告警案件助理、客服工單派發、授信審查、交易模型及稽核底稿等領域。
林建忠透露，受惠於流程自動化與生產力提升，遠東銀今年初至今全行員工人數自然精簡約70至80人，使人事與營業費用得以嚴格控制。他同時強調「審慎治理」的重要性，未來一名行員可能同時管理數十個AI代理，但最終決策與犯錯責任仍在於行員本身，因此遠東銀特別建立「數位員工應用管理與技術作業規範」，確保在風險可控的前提下發揮AI最大綜效。
除了AI賦能，遠東銀也持續擴大金融生態圈版圖，截至今年第3季底，數位銀行「Bankee」存款餘額年增10%，占全行總存款比重突破 4%(約326億元)；同時積極拓展VASP新客戶並試辦數位資產保管業務，並切入「醫療金融生態圈」，針對診所與藥局採購場景導入企業卡，延伸「白袍BOSS」醫療專案貸款商品。
展望2027年總體經濟與金融市場走勢，林建忠直言，「明年變數比今年大非常多」，並點出兩大核心觀察指標，首先是美國關稅政策動向(如301條款重新評估)及通膨黏著度，若美國聯準會年底或明年再度升息，台灣央行恐面臨跟進升息半碼以縮小利差的壓力；其次則是全球AI算力與基礎建設的龐大融資與投資，未來能否順利產生合理的商業回收，將牽動金融業的授信與投資風險。
林建忠表示，面對明年財富管理手續費基期墊高、股債市場波動加劇的挑戰，遠東銀將適度調整商品策略，強化保險類商品銷售以平衡股債波動，並持續優化資金成本與風險胃納調節，在穩健經營體質下追求長期價值成長。
paras_en: Far Eastern Commercial Bank (2845‑TW) held its third‑quarter earnings conference today (26th). General manager Lin Chien‑chung said the move into the Asia Asset Management Center’s Kaohsiung zone is expected to be approved by the end of this year and to officially open on January 8, 2027, further expanding its high‑net‑worth and family‑office businesses. Regarding AI transformation, 88 of the bank’s 127 AI proposals are now AI agents, focusing on helping staff handle VASP alerts, customer service and credit tasks. From the start of the year the bank has naturally trimmed about 70‑80 employees and stresses the need to manage AI‑agent risk under prudent governance. He warned that “next year’s variables are far greater than this year’s,” urging attention to U.S. tariffs, rate hikes and AI investment returns.

Lin said Far Eastern Bank obtained its Wealth Management 2.0 licence in July and began operations, then accelerated the rollout of an “Asia Asset Management Center.” The plan is to secure regulatory approval by year‑end and open in Kaohsiung on January 8, 2027, leveraging the family‑office foundation set up in 2020 to capture high‑net‑worth clients and overseas capital repatriation opportunities.

On digital transformation and AI use, the bank has accumulated 127 AI‑application proposals, of which 88 (about 69%) have entered the “Agent AI” stage, covering 35 generative‑AI projects and 4 analytical‑AI projects. Lin noted that, compared with generative AI which still requires strict controls in finance, the bank is focusing on Agent AI to assist staff with practical tasks such as VASP alert assistance, customer‑service ticket routing, credit review, transaction modelling and audit documentation.

Lin disclosed that, thanks to process automation and productivity gains, the bank has naturally reduced its headcount by roughly 70‑80 people since the start of the year, allowing tight control of personnel and operating expenses. He emphasized the importance of “prudent governance”; a single employee may manage dozens of AI agents, but final decisions and liability remain with the employee. Accordingly, the bank has established a “Digital Employee Application Management and Technical Operations Standard” to ensure AI delivers maximum benefit within controllable risk.

Beyond AI, the bank continues to expand its financial ecosystem. As of the end of Q3 this year, the digital bank “Bankee” saw deposits grow 10% year‑on‑year, accounting for over 4% of total deposits (about NT$32.6 billion). It is also actively acquiring new VASP clients, piloting digital‑asset custody services, and entering a “medical finance ecosystem” by issuing corporate cards for clinics and pharmacies and extending the “White‑Coat BOSS” medical‑project loan product.

Looking ahead to the 2027 macro‑economic and financial‑market outlook, Lin bluntly said “next year’s variables are far greater than this year’s.” He highlighted two core observation points: first, U.S. tariff policy developments (such as a re‑assessment of Section 301) and inflation stickiness; if the Fed raises rates again at year‑end or next year, the Taiwan central bank may feel pressure to follow with a half‑point hike to narrow the rate spread. Second, the massive financing and investment in global AI computing power and infrastructure, and whether reasonable commercial returns can be achieved, will affect credit and investment risk in the financial sector.

Lin said that facing higher base‑year wealth‑management fees and heightened equity‑bond market volatility next year, Far Eastern Bank will moderately adjust its product strategy, strengthen insurance‑product sales to offset market swings, and continue to optimise funding costs and risk appetite, pursuing long‑term value growth while maintaining a sound operating foundation.

items.title: 2027台北自行車展以「信任驅動未來」為主題 11/26參觀預先登記開跑
items.title_en: 2027 Taipei Bicycle Expo Themes “Trust Drives the Future”, Pre‑Registration Opens on Nov 26
paras: 全球自行車產業正面臨市場轉型、智慧科技與永續發展等多重挑戰，深化國際合作，成為產業關注焦點，由貿協主辦的「台北國際自行車展(TAIPEI CYCLE 2027)」將於明(2027)年3月24至27日在南港展覽館登場，此次以「信任驅動未來」為全新策略定位，強化台灣在全球高階自行車產業的平台角色，今(26)日起開放參觀者線上預先登記。
貿協表示，台灣自行車產業的硬實力，不僅來自精密工程與製造技術，更源於長年累積的品質表現、合作關係與產業承諾，TAIPEI CYCLE 2027以品質信任、夥伴信任、法規信任及長期承諾信任為四大核心，回應全球市場對供應鏈透明、ESG與跨國協作的要求。
此次展覽也將透過「全球自行車樞紐」、「亞洲首選舞台」及「全方位台灣體驗」三大策略支柱，整合全新合規專區、商務媒合、創新設計獎項與騎行文化活動，向國際買主展現臺灣自行車產業的技術實力與合作價值。
貿協強調，本屆「Taipei Cycle × Bike Trend」國際論壇規劃2天六場重磅主題，首日聚焦E-Bike與大數據、自行車產業的跨國布局與傳承，以及AI在運動科技、騎乘數據與智慧產品上的應用，提供產業掌握未來發展方向的交流機會。
第2天則將視角延伸至消費市場與騎行生活，探討新單車文化、台灣自行車賽事及三鐵運動發展，串聯產業端、經銷通路與騎行愛好者，展現自行車從專業製造走向多元生活文化的無限可能。
除展館內的產品展示，睽違8年的Demo Day將於2027年3月23日重返台北彩虹河濱公園開放戶外試乘，下午至晚間舉辦產業交流派對，透過實際騎乘，國際買主可直接感受新品的操作特性與設計表現，將產品信任轉化為實際體驗，Demo Day 戶外展示攤位限額 28 個，開放報名至2027年1月20日截止，提供品牌展現產品特色與拓展交流的機會。
paras_en: The global bicycle industry is facing multiple challenges such as market transformation, smart technology and sustainability, prompting deeper international cooperation and becoming a focal point for the sector. Organized by the Taiwan External Trade Development Council, the “Taipei International Bicycle Expo (TAIPEI CYCLE 2027)” will be held from March 24‑27, 2027 at the Nangang Exhibition Hall. This year’s new strategic positioning, “Trust Drives the Future,” aims to strengthen Taiwan’s platform role in the global high‑end bicycle industry, and online pre‑registration for visitors opens today, November 26.

The Trade Development Council says Taiwan’s bicycle industry’s hard power comes not only from precision engineering and manufacturing expertise, but also from years of accumulated quality performance, partnership relationships and industry commitment. TAIPEI CYCLE 2027 is built around four core trusts—quality trust, partner trust, regulatory trust and long‑term commitment trust—to meet global market demands for supply‑chain transparency, ESG and cross‑border collaboration.

The exhibition will also showcase three strategic pillars—“Global Bicycle Hub,” “Asia’s Preferred Stage,” and “All‑Around Taiwan Experience”—integrating a new compliance zone, business matchmaking, innovative design awards and cycling‑culture activities to demonstrate Taiwan’s technical strength and collaborative value to international buyers.

The council emphasizes that the “Taipei Cycle × Bike Trend” international forum will feature six heavyweight sessions over two days. The first day will focus on e‑bikes and big data, the multinational layout and heritage of the bicycle industry, and AI applications in sports technology, riding data and smart products, providing a platform for the industry to grasp future development directions.

The second day will shift the focus to the consumer market and riding lifestyle, exploring new bike culture, Taiwan’s bicycle races and triathlon development, linking manufacturers, distribution channels and cycling enthusiasts, and illustrating the limitless possibilities as bicycles move from professional manufacturing to diverse lifestyle culture.

In addition to product displays inside the venue, the Demo Day—absent for eight years—will return on March 23, 2027 at Taipei’s Rainbow River Park for outdoor test rides. An industry‑exchange party will run from afternoon into evening, allowing international buyers to experience new products firsthand and turn product trust into tangible experience. The outdoor Demo Day will have a limit of 28 booths, with registration open until January 20, 2027, offering brands a chance to showcase product features and expand networking.

items.title: 假短劇App遠端盜轉1742萬元波及22家金融機構 金管會：8銀行有報重偶
items.title_en: Fake Short-Drama App Remote Theft of NT$17.42 Million Affects 22 Financial Institutions, Financial Supervisory Commission: 8 Banks Report Major Incidents
paras: 近期有民眾因下載來路不明的「短劇App」遭植入惡意程式，導致網路銀行帳戶遭遠端遙控盜轉。根據刑事局統計，截至21日已有18家銀行、1家證券商及3家電子支付機構共22家金融機構用戶受害，累計財損達1,742萬元。金管會今(26)日在例行記者會上說明，目前共有 8 家銀行通報「重大偶發事件」，涉及10名客戶、金額約182萬元；至於賠償責任歸屬，則需視個案情況而定。
針對金管會與刑事局公布的數據落差，銀行局主任秘書陳家珍解釋，兩者統計基礎不同，刑事局的數據是依據「民眾向警方報案」的案件進行統計；金管會的數據則是依據「金融機構通報重大偶發事件」的紀錄。
陳家珍指出，民眾報案後，銀行端未必會第一時間知情，且即使知情，銀行也會依內部標準評估事件情節是否達到需通報重大偶發的程度，兩者並不衝突。截至目前，已向金管會通報重大偶發的銀行共有8家，除了上周公布的中信、玉山、富邦、華南外，新增了合庫、彰銀、台新、一銀4家，共計10位客戶受影響，盜轉總金額為182萬元。
至於刑事局提到有1家證券商與3家電子支付機構受波及，陳家珍表示，目前尚未收到電子支付機構的通報；證期局副局長黃仲豪補充，該券商因投資人反映「未下單卻出現紀錄」，券商並未通報資安事件，金管會已請證交所介入了解，釐清是系統問題或投資人誤觸預約單所致。
刑事局調查發現，被害人多是透過非官方管道下載偽冒「黃果、紅果、抖陰」等短劇App安裝檔(APK)，並在誘導下開啟VPN連線與手機「無障礙」權限，導致駭客在1分鐘內取得簡訊與螢幕控制權，進而側錄網銀帳密並攔截、刪除OTP驗證碼。
媒體關注，若因民眾自行下載不明 App 並開啟權限導致遭盜轉，責任是否全歸於民眾、銀行得以免責？對此，陳家珍回應，責任歸屬與求償問題仍需「回歸個案情況」認定；若民眾與銀行端對責任歸屬存有爭議，可循金融消費評議中心的評議機制申請處理。
陳家珍表示，金管會將從三大面向防範類似盜轉手法擴大，第一，強化金融機構防禦，要求銀行持續提升資安防禦與應變能力，並請銀行公會針對此次新型態盜轉手法，研議銀行端可再精進的防護措施。
第二，密切警銀合作，金融機構將與執法機關保持密切聯繫，全力配合警方偵辦；至於資金流向是否全數流入詐騙集團帳戶，因案件仍在偵辦中，不便對外透露。
第三，加強客戶端宣導，責成金融機構向客戶加強宣導，提醒切勿下載來源不明的App或點擊可疑連結。
刑事局也再次提醒民眾務必落實防範措施，切勿從官方商店以外的網站或連結下載App，若遇不明App要求開啟「VPN連線」或「無障礙／協助工具」權限應一律拒絕，網銀驗證建議優先綁定指紋或臉部辨識。若發現手機出現異常自行操作或畫面遭遮蓋，應立即斷網、關機(或拔除SIM卡)，並以其他電話聯繫銀行凍結帳戶及撥打165報案，同時保留手機原狀切勿恢復原廠設定，以利警方採證。
paras_en: Recently, some people who downloaded a suspicious “short‑drama app” had malicious software installed, allowing remote hijacking of their online banking accounts. According to the Criminal Investigation Bureau, as of the 21st, victims include users of 18 banks, one securities firm and three e‑payment providers – a total of 22 financial institutions – with cumulative losses of NT$17.42 million. The Financial Supervisory Commission said at its regular press conference on the 26th that eight banks have reported “major incidental events,” involving ten customers and about NT$1.82 million; liability for compensation will depend on the specifics of each case.

Regarding the discrepancy between the figures released by the FSC and the Criminal Investigation Bureau, Chen Jia‑zhen, secretary‑general of the Banking Bureau, explained that the two agencies use different bases: the bureau’s numbers come from police reports filed by the public, while the FSC’s figures are based on “major incidental events” reported by financial institutions.

Chen noted that after a report is filed, a bank may not learn of it immediately, and even if it does, the bank will assess internally whether the incident meets the threshold for a major incidental report, so the two sets of data are not contradictory. To date, eight banks have reported major incidents to the FSC – besides the previously announced China Trust, E‑Sun, Fubon and Hua Nan, the list now includes Cooperative, Chang Hwa, Taishin and First Commercial Bank – affecting ten customers in total and a total stolen amount of NT$1.82 million.

As for the Criminal Investigation Bureau’s mention of one securities firm and three e‑payment providers being affected, Chen said no e‑payment provider has yet reported anything. Securities and Futures Bureau deputy director Huang Chung‑hao added that the securities firm received a complaint that “a trade record appeared without any order”; the firm did not report a cybersecurity incident, and the FSC has asked the Taiwan Stock Exchange to investigate whether the issue was a system glitch or an investor’s accidental reservation order.

The Criminal Investigation Bureau found that most victims had downloaded counterfeit short‑drama apps such as “Yellow Fruit,” “Red Fruit” or “Douyin” from unofficial sources (APK files). Under the apps’ prompts, users enabled a VPN connection and the phone’s “accessibility” permission, allowing hackers within a minute to capture SMS messages and screen control, record online‑banking credentials and intercept or delete OTP codes.

The media asked whether, when users themselves download unknown apps and grant permissions that lead to theft, the liability falls entirely on the users, allowing banks to escape responsibility. Chen replied that liability and compensation issues must be assessed on a case‑by‑case basis; if disputes arise between users and banks, they can apply to the Financial Consumer Evaluation Center’s mediation mechanism.

Chen said the FSC will expand its prevention of similar theft methods on three fronts: first, strengthening financial‑institution defenses by requiring banks to continuously improve cybersecurity defenses and response capabilities, and asking the Bankers’ Association to study additional protective measures against this new type of theft.

Second, tightening police‑bank cooperation; financial institutions will maintain close contact with law‑enforcement agencies and fully cooperate with investigations. As for whether all stolen funds have been transferred to fraud‑group accounts, the case is still under investigation and details cannot be disclosed.
Third, enhancing customer education; financial institutions are tasked with informing customers not to download apps from unknown sources or click suspicious links.

The Criminal Investigation Bureau also reminded the public to implement preventive measures: do not download apps from sites or links outside official app stores; refuse any app that requests VPN connections or accessibility/assistive‑tool permissions; prioritize fingerprint or facial recognition for online‑banking authentication; if the phone behaves oddly or the screen is obscured, immediately disconnect from the network, power off (or remove the SIM), contact the bank via another phone to freeze the account and call 165 to report, and preserve the phone’s state without resetting it to aid police evidence collection.

items.title: 漲價推升舊旗艦殘值 10月二手機回收價逆勢走揚 小米15T Pro漲幅24%居冠
items.title_en: Price Hikes Boost Old Flagship Residual Value; October Used-Phone Buyback Prices Rise Against the Trend, Xiaomi 15T Pro Leads with 24% Increase
paras: 全球記憶體與先進晶片報價持續在高檔盤旋，迫使新款中階手機面臨定價調漲或規格妥協的兩難，進而凸顯高規格舊旗艦的保值優勢。在雙11購物節前夕的備貨潮帶動下，傑昇通信公布2026年10月二手機回收增值排行榜前十名，motorola首款書本式大摺疊旗艦Razr Fold（12GB/256GB）以單月增值2,170元表現奪冠，最高回收價一舉推升至24,620元；比較特別的是，榜上機型全數搭載12GB以上記憶體，宣告二手機定價正式進入規格稀缺性主導的時代。

觀察本月奪下回收榜首的motorola Razr Fold，傑昇通信分析，回收報價的走揚集中在機況良好且具備高階硬體配置的旗艦機種。而Razr Fold自今年六月登台以來，在市場上的流通數量有限，二手回收商為滿足終端市場對大摺疊機的需求，遂在十月大幅上調收購價格，不僅讓Razr Fold拿下回收增值冠軍，更打破過去消費者認為摺疊手機折舊速度過快的刻板印象；以該機型九月底22,450元的收購行情計算，消費者若於十月變現，等於能再多拿回2,170元的殘值補貼。
受惠於高階影像與摺疊溢價的還有vivo與小米兩大品牌，兩者合計囊括榜單六個席次，又以今年上市的vivo X300 Ultra與小米17 Ultra分居二、三名，單月增值金額皆超過1,500元，回收增幅近一成，顯示具備頂級光學鏡頭與大容量儲存空間的旗艦機皇，在通膨環境下依然擁有最堅實的資產護城河。
傑昇通信表示，過去二手機市場收購價格起伏，看的是「品牌光環」，然而在面對年底換機旺季時，回收商寧願提高收購成本搶奪高規格稀缺良品，也不願在低階庫存上過度壓寶。
除了頂級旗艦展現抗跌韌性，中階輕旗艦與跨代電競機型在十月也上演驚人的補漲行情。小米在十月推出新一代17T Pro後，新機的定價策略產生外溢效應，不僅帶動品牌回收價單月上揚12%，連帶拉抬前代機型小米15T Pro 5G單月暴漲24%，奪下全榜單最高漲幅冠軍。
值得關注的是華碩電競系列，兩年前發表的ROG Phone 8與ROG Phone 7雙雙擠進前十名，回收漲幅分別高達17%與23%，傑昇通信指出，在血統純正的電競手機市場漸趨小眾的背景下，具備16GB記憶體與高效能散熱架構的歷代電競機王，已成為手遊玩家與二手機商眼中的稀缺資產。
從十月份二手機回收行情的變化可看出，高規格硬體配置與大記憶體容量已成為決定舊機殘值的核心分水嶺。特別是十月底回收報價提高、形成新不如舊的奇特現象，反映回收業者趕在雙11購物節與年底換機潮前夕預先囤貨的策略。
傑昇通信坦言，目前新款手機不是定價調漲就是降規開倒車，使這一兩年問世的12GB與16GB大記憶體旗艦機顯得格外超值，成為撐起二手機市場收購熱度的主力，考量舊機回收溢價仰賴檔期備貨動能支撐，加上接連而來的年終購物促銷檔期到來，持有高規舊機的民眾若能及早趁價格高點變現，才能順利鎖住當前的殘值紅利。
paras_en: Global memory and advanced chip prices continue to hover at high levels, forcing new mid‑range phones into a dilemma of either raising prices or compromising specs, which highlights the value‑preserving advantage of high‑spec old flagships. Ahead of the Double‑11 shopping festival, a surge in stockpiling led Jiesheng Communications to release its October 2026 used‑phone resale value ranking. Motorola’s first book‑style large‑fold flagship, the Razr Fold (12GB/256GB), topped the list with a monthly value increase of NT$2,170, pushing its highest resale price to NT$24,620. Notably, every model on the list is equipped with at least 12GB of memory, signalling that used‑phone pricing has entered an era dominated by spec scarcity.

Observing the Motorola Razr Fold that captured the top spot this month, Jiesheng Communications notes that the price surge is concentrated on well‑conditioned flagship devices with high‑end hardware. Since its launch in June, the Razr Fold has had limited circulation, and used‑phone buyers raised purchase prices sharply in October to meet market demand for large‑fold phones. This not only made the Razr Fold the resale value champion but also shattered the stereotype that foldable phones depreciate quickly; based on the end‑September purchase price of NT$22,450, a consumer selling in October would receive an extra NT$2,170 in residual value.

Benefiting from premium imaging and foldable premiums are the two major brands Vivo and Xiaomi, which together occupy six slots on the list. This year’s Vivo X300 Ultra and Xiaomi 17 Ultra take second and third places, each adding more than NT$1,500 in a single month—a near‑10% increase—showing that flagship phones with top‑tier optics and large storage still possess the strongest asset moat in an inflationary environment.

Jiesheng Communications says that historically used‑phone purchase prices were driven by "brand halo," but during the year‑end upgrade season, buyers are willing to raise acquisition costs to snap up high‑spec scarce units rather than over‑discount low‑end inventory.

Beyond top‑tier flagships showing resilience, mid‑range light flagships and cross‑generation gaming phones also saw remarkable price rebounds in October. After Xiaomi launched the new 17T Pro in October, its pricing strategy created a spill‑over effect, lifting the brand’s overall resale prices by 12% in a single month and propelling the previous‑generation Xiaomi 15T Pro 5G to a staggering 24% jump, the highest increase on the entire list.

Worth noting is ASUS’s gaming series: the ROG Phone 8 and ROG Phone 7, released two years ago, both cracked the top ten, with resale gains of 17% and 23% respectively. Jiesheng points out that as the pure‑line gaming phone market becomes more niche, generations of gaming flagships equipped with 16GB RAM and high‑efficiency cooling have become scarce assets prized by mobile‑game players and used‑phone traders alike.

The October used‑phone resale trends reveal that high‑spec hardware and large memory capacities have become the key dividing line for residual values. Especially the late‑October price hikes, creating a rare “new‑is‑worse‑than‑old” phenomenon, reflect buyers stockpiling ahead of the Double‑11 festival and the year‑end upgrade wave.

Jiesheng admits that new phones are either priced higher or downgraded in specs, making the 12GB and 16GB flagship models released in the past couple of years especially cost‑effective and the main drivers of used‑phone market activity. Since old‑phone premium values rely on stock‑building momentum and the upcoming year‑end sales periods, owners of high‑spec older devices who cash out early at peak prices can lock in the current residual‑value dividend.

items.title: 滙豐看好2027年：AI震盪反而創造進場甜蜜點
items.title_en: HSBC bullish on 2027: AI turbulence instead creates a sweet entry point
paras: 對投資人而言，現在似乎不是特別有利的時刻：通膨持續頑強攀升，聯準會(Fed)似乎幾乎確定將再次升息。與此同時，人工智慧(AI)交易正讓市場劇烈震盪，如今關稅議題也再度浮上檯面。但滙豐控股(HSBC)策略師卻認為，股市實際上可能正處於一個難得的甜蜜點。
滙豐新興市場及全球股票策略主管Alastair Pinder表示，近期由AI造成的全球股市波動，實際上已改善2027年的風險報酬比。
他認為，股市雖然已從高點大幅回落，但實際情況只是股票變得更便宜，而非陷入持續下跌的漩渦。
Pinder寫道：「若要讓這波跌勢演變成更持久的空頭市場，導致估值下修的壓力就必須大幅升高，包括市場對AI變現能力的疑慮、債券殖利率上升及聯準會(Fed)立場更加鷹派，以及能源價格再度帶來壓力。我們預期情況將朝相反方向發展。」

超大型雲端業者現金流可望觸底 企業導入AI有望提升生產力

儘管許多投資人擔心大型科技公司為建置AI基礎設施而大規模舉債，Pinder預料，美國超大型雲端服務業者的自由現金流將在2027年上半年觸底，之後隨著雲端營收預估加速成長、資本支出放緩而回升。
此外，隨著更多企業採用AI，應該會開始看到生產力提升的實際證據。
雖然市場幾乎篤定Fed下個月將升息，但目前市場已反映Fed至2027年年中累計升息65個基點的預期，「導致鷹派意外出現的門檻很高」。此外，能源價格的基期效應自明年3月起將轉趨有利，可能減輕通膨壓力。
他也指出，從歷史經驗來看，在Fed升息幅度較溫和的緊縮周期中，標普500指數在前12個月平均上漲16%。
與此同時，股票估值「開始反映最糟情境……全球科技股估值目前隱含的中期EPS成長率接近零，遠低於2025年年中約25%的水準」。
美國及國際股市近期的跌勢，似乎與2027年企業獲利仍可能保持穩健的情況不相符。目前市場共識預估，標普500指數成分股明年每股盈餘將年增17%。
換句話說，在美國企業獲利展現韌性、股票估值相對溫和的情況下，隨著AI投資放緩、生產力提升效益逐漸顯現，股市在2027年可能再度走揚。
不過，凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)資深市場經濟學家James Reilly提醒，市場共識預估往往落後於實際情況，歷史經驗也顯示，企業獲利預估很可能下修。他寫道：「即使只是對分析師的獲利預期進行溫和下修，美股看起來仍相對昂貴。」
儘管如此，Pinder對經濟成長前景仍較為樂觀。考量美國企業獲利成長前景強勁，他對美股維持加碼，至於新興市場在近期遭遇賣壓之後，估值已降至過低水準，因此也予以加碼。他對歐股維持中立，對日股則採取減碼立場。
Pinder說：「我們偏好資產負債表穩健的企業，尤其是半導體製造商及超大型雲端服務業者。隨著經濟成長維持韌性，我們也看好景氣循環股，除了科技股之外，金融、工業及原物料類股也都維持加碼。」
paras_en: For investors, now does not seem like a particularly favorable moment: inflation remains stubbornly high, the Fed appears almost certain to raise rates again, AI trading is causing market volatility, and tariff issues have resurfaced. Yet HSBC strategists believe the equity market may actually be at a rare sweet spot.

Alastair Pinder, head of emerging markets and global equity strategy at HSBC, said that the recent AI‑driven volatility in global equity markets has actually improved the risk‑return profile for 2027.
He believes that although the market has pulled back sharply from its highs, the reality is simply that stocks have become cheaper, not that they are caught in a persistent down‑trend.

Pinder wrote: “For this pull‑back to turn into a longer‑lasting bear market, the pressure to cut valuations would have to rise sharply, including doubts about AI’s monetisation, rising bond yields, a more hawkish Fed stance, and renewed energy‑price pressures. We expect the opposite to happen.”

Despite many investors worrying that large tech firms are taking on massive debt to build AI infrastructure, Pinder expects the free cash flow of U.S. hyperscale cloud providers to bottom in the first half of 2027 and then recover as cloud revenue forecasts accelerate and capital spending slows.
Moreover, as more companies adopt AI, we should start seeing tangible evidence of productivity gains.

While the market is almost certain the Fed will raise rates next month, it has already priced in expectations of a cumulative 65‑basis‑point hike by mid‑2027, making the threshold for an unexpected hawkish shift very high. In addition, the base‑effect of energy prices is set to turn favourable from March next year, potentially easing inflation pressures.
He also noted that historically, during periods of relatively moderate Fed tightening, the S&P 500 has risen an average of 16% over the first 12 months.

At the same time, stock valuations are “starting to reflect the worst‑case scenario… the implied mid‑term EPS growth rate for global tech stocks is now near zero, far below the roughly 25% level seen around mid‑2025.”

The recent declines in U.S. and international equity markets seem at odds with the view that corporate earnings could remain robust in 2027. The consensus now expects S&P 500 component companies to post a 17% year‑over‑year earnings per share increase next year.

In other words, with resilient U.S. corporate earnings and relatively moderate valuations, combined with a slowdown in AI spending and gradually materialising productivity benefits, the market could rally again in 2027.

However, James Reilly, senior market economist at Capital Economics, warned that consensus forecasts often lag reality and historically earnings forecasts are likely to be revised down. He wrote: “Even a modest downgrade of analysts’ earnings expectations would make U.S. equities still look relatively expensive.”

Nevertheless, Pinder remains more optimistic about growth prospects. Given the strong earnings outlook for U.S. companies, he maintains a net‑add stance on U.S. equities, and after recent selling pressure has pushed emerging‑market valuations to overly low levels, he is also adding there. He stays neutral on European stocks and is reducing exposure to Japanese equities.

Pinder said: “We prefer companies with strong balance sheets, especially semiconductor manufacturers and hyperscale cloud providers. With economic growth remaining resilient, we are also bullish on cyclical stocks – beyond tech, we are adding to financials, industrials and materials.”

items.title: 立碁台中路燈汰換案訴訟落幕 與台中市府達成調解可望進帳9937萬元
paras: LED封裝廠立碁(8111-TW)今(26)日公告，與臺中市政府建設局針對臺中市水銀路燈落日計畫汰換工程案訴訟達成調解，雙方於臺灣高等法院臺中分院工程法庭調解成立，臺中市政府建設局同意給付立碁本金加計年息5%之利息，合計共新台幣9937.4萬元，預計將於民國116年2月23日前完成給付。
立碁公告，此次調解標的為臺中市水銀路燈落日計畫汰換工程案第八工程西屯、南屯及中、西區之爭議款項，臺中市政府建設局同意給付本金7017.1萬元，以及自民國107年8月28日起至115年12月23日止之利息2920.2萬元。立碁表示，本次調解結果對公司財務與業務並無重大影響，後續將依調解內容進行款項收取作業。
回顧本案訴訟歷程，繼一審與二審判決後，臺中市政府建設局原預計給付立碁新台幣7711.5萬元及相關法定利息。隨後經最高法院三審判決，廢棄二審判決再給付中之新台幣1274.4萬元本息及該部分訴訟費用，並將全案發回臺灣高等法院臺中分院更一審，最終雙方於更一審階段順利達成調解共識。

items.title: 〈遠東銀法說〉搶進亞資高雄專區拚明年1月開業 總座示警2027總經變數更多
items.title_en: Far Eastern Bank's Earnings Call: Rushing into Asia Asset Management Kaohsiung Zone for January 2027 Opening, CEO Warns More Economic Variables in 2027
paras: 遠東商銀(2845-TW)今(26)日舉行第三季法說會，總經理林建忠指出，進駐亞資中心高雄專區案預計今年底獲准、明(2027)年1月8日正式開業，將進一步推展高資產與家族辦公室業務。AI 轉型方面，全行 127 項提案中 88 項為 AI 代理，聚焦助員工處理 VASP 告警、客服與授信等任務，今年初至今員工人數自然精簡約七、八十人，並強調須在審慎治理下管理AI代理風險。談及明年總經，林建忠提醒「明年變數比今年大非常多」，應留意美國關稅、升息及AI投資回收。
林建忠表示，遠東銀今年 7 月已取得財富管理 2.0 執照並正式開業，緊接著全力衝刺「亞洲資產管理中心」布局，預計今年底前可獲主管機關核准，並於明(2027)年1月8日在高雄正式開業，結合 2020 年即成立的家族辦公室基礎，搶攻高資產客戶與海外資金回流商機。

在數位轉型與AI應用方面，遠東銀目前全行AI應用提案已累積達127項，其中高達88項(占比69%)已邁入「AI代理(Agent AI)」階段，涵蓋 35 項生成式 AI 與 4 項分析式 AI。林建忠表示，相較於生成式 AI 在金融業仍須高度審慎控管，遠東銀更聚焦讓 Agent AI 協助員工處理實務作業，包括虛擬資產服務商(VASP)告警案件助理、客服工單派發、授信審查、交易模型及稽核底稿等領域。
林建忠透露，受惠於流程自動化與生產力提升，遠東銀今年初至今全行員工人數自然精簡約70至80人，使人事與營業費用得以嚴格控制。他同時強調「審慎治理」的重要性，未來一名行員可能同時管理數十個AI代理，但最終決策與犯錯責任仍在於行員本身，因此遠東銀特別建立「數位員工應用管理與技術作業規範」，確保在風險可控的前提下發揮AI最大綜效。
除了AI賦能，遠東銀也持續擴大金融生態圈版圖，截至今年第3季底，數位銀行「Bankee」存款餘額年增10%，占全行總存款比重突破 4%(約326億元)；同時積極拓展VASP新客戶並試辦數位資產保管業務，並切入「醫療金融生態圈」，針對診所與藥局採購場景導入企業卡，延伸「白袍BOSS」醫療專案貸款商品。
展望2027年總體經濟與金融市場走勢，林建忠直言，「明年變數比今年大非常多」，並點出兩大核心觀察指標，首先是美國關稅政策動向(如301條款重新評估)及通膨黏著度，若美國聯準會年底或明年再度升息，台灣央行恐面臨跟進升息半碼以縮小利差的壓力；其次則是全球AI算力與基礎建設的龐大融資與投資，未來能否順利產生合理的商業回收，將牽動金融業的授信與投資風險。
林建忠表示，面對明年財富管理手續費基期墊高、股債市場波動加劇的挑戰，遠東銀將適度調整商品策略，強化保險類商品銷售以平衡股債波動，並持續優化資金成本與風險胃納調節，在穩健經營體質下追求長期價值成長。
paras_en: Far Eastern Commercial Bank (2845‑TW) held its third‑quarter earnings conference today (26th). General manager Lin Chien‑chung said the move into the Asia Asset Management Center’s Kaohsiung zone is expected to be approved by the end of this year and to officially open on January 8, 2027, further expanding its high‑net‑worth and family‑office businesses. Regarding AI transformation, 88 of the bank’s 127 AI proposals are now AI agents, focusing on helping staff handle VASP alerts, customer service and credit tasks. From the start of the year the bank has naturally trimmed about 70‑80 employees and stresses the need to manage AI‑agent risk under prudent governance. He warned that “next year’s variables are far greater than this year’s,” urging attention to U.S. tariffs, rate hikes and AI investment returns.

Lin said Far Eastern Bank obtained its Wealth Management 2.0 licence in July and began operations, then accelerated the rollout of an “Asia Asset Management Center.” The plan is to secure regulatory approval by year‑end and open in Kaohsiung on January 8, 2027, leveraging the family‑office foundation set up in 2020 to capture high‑net‑worth clients and overseas capital repatriation opportunities.

On digital transformation and AI use, the bank has accumulated 127 AI‑application proposals, of which 88 (about 69%) have entered the “Agent AI” stage, covering 35 generative‑AI projects and 4 analytical‑AI projects. Lin noted that, compared with generative AI which still requires strict controls in finance, the bank is focusing on Agent AI to assist staff with practical tasks such as VASP alert assistance, customer‑service ticket routing, credit review, transaction modelling and audit documentation.

Lin disclosed that, thanks to process automation and productivity gains, the bank has naturally reduced its headcount by roughly 70‑80 people since the start of the year, allowing tight control of personnel and operating expenses. He emphasized the importance of “prudent governance”; a single employee may manage dozens of AI agents, but final decisions and liability remain with the employee. Accordingly, the bank has established a “Digital Employee Application Management and Technical Operations Standard” to ensure AI delivers maximum benefit within controllable risk.

Beyond AI, the bank continues to expand its financial ecosystem. As of the end of Q3 this year, the digital bank “Bankee” saw deposits grow 10% year‑on‑year, accounting for over 4% of total deposits (about NT$32.6 billion). It is also actively acquiring new VASP clients, piloting digital‑asset custody services, and entering a “medical finance ecosystem” by issuing corporate cards for clinics and pharmacies and extending the “White‑Coat BOSS” medical‑project loan product.

Looking ahead to the 2027 macro‑economic and financial‑market outlook, Lin bluntly said “next year’s variables are far greater than this year’s.” He highlighted two core observation points: first, U.S. tariff policy developments (such as a re‑assessment of Section 301) and inflation stickiness; if the Fed raises rates again at year‑end or next year, the Taiwan central bank may feel pressure to follow with a half‑point hike to narrow the rate spread. Second, the massive financing and investment in global AI computing power and infrastructure, and whether reasonable commercial returns can be achieved, will affect credit and investment risk in the financial sector.

Lin said that facing higher base‑year wealth‑management fees and heightened equity‑bond market volatility next year, Far Eastern Bank will moderately adjust its product strategy, strengthen insurance‑product sales to offset market swings, and continue to optimise funding costs and risk appetite, pursuing long‑term value growth while maintaining a sound operating foundation.

items.title: 2027台北自行車展以「信任驅動未來」為主題 11/26參觀預先登記開跑
items.title_en: 2027 Taipei Bicycle Expo Themes “Trust Drives the Future”, Pre‑Registration Opens on Nov 26
paras: 全球自行車產業正面臨市場轉型、智慧科技與永續發展等多重挑戰，深化國際合作，成為產業關注焦點，由貿協主辦的「台北國際自行車展(TAIPEI CYCLE 2027)」將於明(2027)年3月24至27日在南港展覽館登場，此次以「信任驅動未來」為全新策略定位，強化台灣在全球高階自行車產業的平台角色，今(26)日起開放參觀者線上預先登記。
貿協表示，台灣自行車產業的硬實力，不僅來自精密工程與製造技術，更源於長年累積的品質表現、合作關係與產業承諾，TAIPEI CYCLE 2027以品質信任、夥伴信任、法規信任及長期承諾信任為四大核心，回應全球市場對供應鏈透明、ESG與跨國協作的要求。
此次展覽也將透過「全球自行車樞紐」、「亞洲首選舞台」及「全方位台灣體驗」三大策略支柱，整合全新合規專區、商務媒合、創新設計獎項與騎行文化活動，向國際買主展現臺灣自行車產業的技術實力與合作價值。
貿協強調，本屆「Taipei Cycle × Bike Trend」國際論壇規劃2天六場重磅主題，首日聚焦E-Bike與大數據、自行車產業的跨國布局與傳承，以及AI在運動科技、騎乘數據與智慧產品上的應用，提供產業掌握未來發展方向的交流機會。
第2天則將視角延伸至消費市場與騎行生活，探討新單車文化、台灣自行車賽事及三鐵運動發展，串聯產業端、經銷通路與騎行愛好者，展現自行車從專業製造走向多元生活文化的無限可能。
除展館內的產品展示，睽違8年的Demo Day將於2027年3月23日重返台北彩虹河濱公園開放戶外試乘，下午至晚間舉辦產業交流派對，透過實際騎乘，國際買主可直接感受新品的操作特性與設計表現，將產品信任轉化為實際體驗，Demo Day 戶外展示攤位限額 28 個，開放報名至2027年1月20日截止，提供品牌展現產品特色與拓展交流的機會。
paras_en: The global bicycle industry is facing multiple challenges such as market transformation, smart technology and sustainability, prompting deeper international cooperation and becoming a focal point for the sector. Organized by the Taiwan External Trade Development Council, the “Taipei International Bicycle Expo (TAIPEI CYCLE 2027)” will be held from March 24‑27, 2027 at the Nangang Exhibition Hall. This year’s new strategic positioning, “Trust Drives the Future,” aims to strengthen Taiwan’s platform role in the global high‑end bicycle industry, and online pre‑registration for visitors opens today, November 26.

The Trade Development Council says Taiwan’s bicycle industry’s hard power comes not only from precision engineering and manufacturing expertise, but also from years of accumulated quality performance, partnership relationships and industry commitment. TAIPEI CYCLE 2027 is built around four core trusts—quality trust, partner trust, regulatory trust and long‑term commitment trust—to meet global market demands for supply‑chain transparency, ESG and cross‑border collaboration.

The exhibition will also showcase three strategic pillars—“Global Bicycle Hub,” “Asia’s Preferred Stage,” and “All‑Around Taiwan Experience”—integrating a new compliance zone, business matchmaking, innovative design awards and cycling‑culture activities to demonstrate Taiwan’s technical strength and collaborative value to international buyers.

The council emphasizes that the “Taipei Cycle × Bike Trend” international forum will feature six heavyweight sessions over two days. The first day will focus on e‑bikes and big data, the multinational layout and heritage of the bicycle industry, and AI applications in sports technology, riding data and smart products, providing a platform for the industry to grasp future development directions.

The second day will shift the focus to the consumer market and riding lifestyle, exploring new bike culture, Taiwan’s bicycle races and triathlon development, linking manufacturers, distribution channels and cycling enthusiasts, and illustrating the limitless possibilities as bicycles move from professional manufacturing to diverse lifestyle culture.

In addition to product displays inside the venue, the Demo Day—absent for eight years—will return on March 23, 2027 at Taipei’s Rainbow River Park for outdoor test rides. An industry‑exchange party will run from afternoon into evening, allowing international buyers to experience new products firsthand and turn product trust into tangible experience. The outdoor Demo Day will have a limit of 28 booths, with registration open until January 20, 2027, offering brands a chance to showcase product features and expand networking.

items.title: 假短劇App遠端盜轉1742萬元波及22家金融機構 金管會：8銀行有報重偶
items.title_en: Fake Short-Drama App Remote Theft of NT$17.42 Million Affects 22 Financial Institutions, Financial Supervisory Commission: 8 Banks Report Major Incidents
paras: 近期有民眾因下載來路不明的「短劇App」遭植入惡意程式，導致網路銀行帳戶遭遠端遙控盜轉。根據刑事局統計，截至21日已有18家銀行、1家證券商及3家電子支付機構共22家金融機構用戶受害，累計財損達1,742萬元。金管會今(26)日在例行記者會上說明，目前共有 8 家銀行通報「重大偶發事件」，涉及10名客戶、金額約182萬元；至於賠償責任歸屬，則需視個案情況而定。
針對金管會與刑事局公布的數據落差，銀行局主任秘書陳家珍解釋，兩者統計基礎不同，刑事局的數據是依據「民眾向警方報案」的案件進行統計；金管會的數據則是依據「金融機構通報重大偶發事件」的紀錄。
陳家珍指出，民眾報案後，銀行端未必會第一時間知情，且即使知情，銀行也會依內部標準評估事件情節是否達到需通報重大偶發的程度，兩者並不衝突。截至目前，已向金管會通報重大偶發的銀行共有8家，除了上周公布的中信、玉山、富邦、華南外，新增了合庫、彰銀、台新、一銀4家，共計10位客戶受影響，盜轉總金額為182萬元。
至於刑事局提到有1家證券商與3家電子支付機構受波及，陳家珍表示，目前尚未收到電子支付機構的通報；證期局副局長黃仲豪補充，該券商因投資人反映「未下單卻出現紀錄」，券商並未通報資安事件，金管會已請證交所介入了解，釐清是系統問題或投資人誤觸預約單所致。
刑事局調查發現，被害人多是透過非官方管道下載偽冒「黃果、紅果、抖陰」等短劇App安裝檔(APK)，並在誘導下開啟VPN連線與手機「無障礙」權限，導致駭客在1分鐘內取得簡訊與螢幕控制權，進而側錄網銀帳密並攔截、刪除OTP驗證碼。
媒體關注，若因民眾自行下載不明 App 並開啟權限導致遭盜轉，責任是否全歸於民眾、銀行得以免責？對此，陳家珍回應，責任歸屬與求償問題仍需「回歸個案情況」認定；若民眾與銀行端對責任歸屬存有爭議，可循金融消費評議中心的評議機制申請處理。
陳家珍表示，金管會將從三大面向防範類似盜轉手法擴大，第一，強化金融機構防禦，要求銀行持續提升資安防禦與應變能力，並請銀行公會針對此次新型態盜轉手法，研議銀行端可再精進的防護措施。
第二，密切警銀合作，金融機構將與執法機關保持密切聯繫，全力配合警方偵辦；至於資金流向是否全數流入詐騙集團帳戶，因案件仍在偵辦中，不便對外透露。
第三，加強客戶端宣導，責成金融機構向客戶加強宣導，提醒切勿下載來源不明的App或點擊可疑連結。
刑事局也再次提醒民眾務必落實防範措施，切勿從官方商店以外的網站或連結下載App，若遇不明App要求開啟「VPN連線」或「無障礙／協助工具」權限應一律拒絕，網銀驗證建議優先綁定指紋或臉部辨識。若發現手機出現異常自行操作或畫面遭遮蓋，應立即斷網、關機(或拔除SIM卡)，並以其他電話聯繫銀行凍結帳戶及撥打165報案，同時保留手機原狀切勿恢復原廠設定，以利警方採證。
paras_en: Recently, some people who downloaded a suspicious “short‑drama app” had malicious software installed, allowing remote hijacking of their online banking accounts. According to the Criminal Investigation Bureau, as of the 21st, victims include users of 18 banks, one securities firm and three e‑payment providers – a total of 22 financial institutions – with cumulative losses of NT$17.42 million. The Financial Supervisory Commission said at its regular press conference on the 26th that eight banks have reported “major incidental events,” involving ten customers and about NT$1.82 million; liability for compensation will depend on the specifics of each case.

Regarding the discrepancy between the figures released by the FSC and the Criminal Investigation Bureau, Chen Jia‑zhen, secretary‑general of the Banking Bureau, explained that the two agencies use different bases: the bureau’s numbers come from police reports filed by the public, while the FSC’s figures are based on “major incidental events” reported by financial institutions.

Chen noted that after a report is filed, a bank may not learn of it immediately, and even if it does, the bank will assess internally whether the incident meets the threshold for a major incidental report, so the two sets of data are not contradictory. To date, eight banks have reported major incidents to the FSC – besides the previously announced China Trust, E‑Sun, Fubon and Hua Nan, the list now includes Cooperative, Chang Hwa, Taishin and First Commercial Bank – affecting ten customers in total and a total stolen amount of NT$1.82 million.

As for the Criminal Investigation Bureau’s mention of one securities firm and three e‑payment providers being affected, Chen said no e‑payment provider has yet reported anything. Securities and Futures Bureau deputy director Huang Chung‑hao added that the securities firm received a complaint that “a trade record appeared without any order”; the firm did not report a cybersecurity incident, and the FSC has asked the Taiwan Stock Exchange to investigate whether the issue was a system glitch or an investor’s accidental reservation order.

The Criminal Investigation Bureau found that most victims had downloaded counterfeit short‑drama apps such as “Yellow Fruit,” “Red Fruit” or “Douyin” from unofficial sources (APK files). Under the apps’ prompts, users enabled a VPN connection and the phone’s “accessibility” permission, allowing hackers within a minute to capture SMS messages and screen control, record online‑banking credentials and intercept or delete OTP codes.

The media asked whether, when users themselves download unknown apps and grant permissions that lead to theft, the liability falls entirely on the users, allowing banks to escape responsibility. Chen replied that liability and compensation issues must be assessed on a case‑by‑case basis; if disputes arise between users and banks, they can apply to the Financial Consumer Evaluation Center’s mediation mechanism.

Chen said the FSC will expand its prevention of similar theft methods on three fronts: first, strengthening financial‑institution defenses by requiring banks to continuously improve cybersecurity defenses and response capabilities, and asking the Bankers’ Association to study additional protective measures against this new type of theft.

Second, tightening police‑bank cooperation; financial institutions will maintain close contact with law‑enforcement agencies and fully cooperate with investigations. As for whether all stolen funds have been transferred to fraud‑group accounts, the case is still under investigation and details cannot be disclosed.
Third, enhancing customer education; financial institutions are tasked with informing customers not to download apps from unknown sources or click suspicious links.

The Criminal Investigation Bureau also reminded the public to implement preventive measures: do not download apps from sites or links outside official app stores; refuse any app that requests VPN connections or accessibility/assistive‑tool permissions; prioritize fingerprint or facial recognition for online‑banking authentication; if the phone behaves oddly or the screen is obscured, immediately disconnect from the network, power off (or remove the SIM), contact the bank via another phone to freeze the account and call 165 to report, and preserve the phone’s state without resetting it to aid police evidence collection.

items.title: 台股收盤／加權指數大漲956點收復3萬9台積電逆勢收黑
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Close: Weighted Index Jumps 956 Points, Recovers to 39,000; TSMC Falls Against the Trend
paras: 2026年11月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 台股26日反彈，加權指數一度上漲逾1,200點，收盤上漲956點、漲幅2.50%，收在39,152點，成交金額約8,175億元。前一日台股下跌1,927點，今天收復約一半跌點，重返39,000點。
這波反彈並非由台積電領軍。台積電(2330-TW)收在2,145元，下跌5元、跌幅0.23%；台達電(2308-TW)上漲6.16%，鴻海(2317-TW)漲4.84%，日月光投控(3711-TW)漲4.71%。記憶體股也走強，南亞科(2408-TW)大漲9.87%。
日本與南韓股市同樣反彈，但都未守住盤中漲幅。日經225指數盤中漲逾2%，終場收漲0.86%；南韓KOSPI早盤也漲逾2%，在南韓央行升息1碼至3.25%後，漲幅收斂至0.29%。

paras_en: On November 26, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center) Taiwan stocks rebounded on the 26th, with the weighted index climbing over 1,200 points at one point and closing up 956 points, a 2.50% gain, at 39,152 points. The total transaction value was about NT$817.5 billion. The previous day the index had fallen 1,927 points, so today it recovered roughly half of that loss and returned above the 39,000 mark.

The rally was not led by TSMC. TSMC (2330‑TW) closed at NT$2,145, down 5 points or 0.23%. Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) rose 6.16%, Hon Hai (2317‑TW) gained 4.84%, and ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) climbed 4.71%. Memory stocks also strengthened, with Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) surging 9.87%.

Japan and South Korea markets also saw rebounds but failed to hold their intraday gains. Japan's Nikkei 225 rose more than 2% during the session but finished up 0.86%; South Korea's KOSPI was up over 2% in early trading, and after the Korean central bank raised rates by one basis point to 3.25%, the gain narrowed to 0.29%.

items.title: 漲價推升舊旗艦殘值 10月二手機回收價逆勢走揚 小米15T Pro漲幅24%居冠
items.title_en: Price Hikes Boost Old Flagship Residual Value; October Used-Phone Buyback Prices Rise Against the Trend, Xiaomi 15T Pro Leads with 24% Increase
paras: 全球記憶體與先進晶片報價持續在高檔盤旋，迫使新款中階手機面臨定價調漲或規格妥協的兩難，進而凸顯高規格舊旗艦的保值優勢。在雙11購物節前夕的備貨潮帶動下，傑昇通信公布2026年10月二手機回收增值排行榜前十名，motorola首款書本式大摺疊旗艦Razr Fold（12GB/256GB）以單月增值2,170元表現奪冠，最高回收價一舉推升至24,620元；比較特別的是，榜上機型全數搭載12GB以上記憶體，宣告二手機定價正式進入規格稀缺性主導的時代。

觀察本月奪下回收榜首的motorola Razr Fold，傑昇通信分析，回收報價的走揚集中在機況良好且具備高階硬體配置的旗艦機種。而Razr Fold自今年六月登台以來，在市場上的流通數量有限，二手回收商為滿足終端市場對大摺疊機的需求，遂在十月大幅上調收購價格，不僅讓Razr Fold拿下回收增值冠軍，更打破過去消費者認為摺疊手機折舊速度過快的刻板印象；以該機型九月底22,450元的收購行情計算，消費者若於十月變現，等於能再多拿回2,170元的殘值補貼。
受惠於高階影像與摺疊溢價的還有vivo與小米兩大品牌，兩者合計囊括榜單六個席次，又以今年上市的vivo X300 Ultra與小米17 Ultra分居二、三名，單月增值金額皆超過1,500元，回收增幅近一成，顯示具備頂級光學鏡頭與大容量儲存空間的旗艦機皇，在通膨環境下依然擁有最堅實的資產護城河。
傑昇通信表示，過去二手機市場收購價格起伏，看的是「品牌光環」，然而在面對年底換機旺季時，回收商寧願提高收購成本搶奪高規格稀缺良品，也不願在低階庫存上過度壓寶。
除了頂級旗艦展現抗跌韌性，中階輕旗艦與跨代電競機型在十月也上演驚人的補漲行情。小米在十月推出新一代17T Pro後，新機的定價策略產生外溢效應，不僅帶動品牌回收價單月上揚12%，連帶拉抬前代機型小米15T Pro 5G單月暴漲24%，奪下全榜單最高漲幅冠軍。
值得關注的是華碩電競系列，兩年前發表的ROG Phone 8與ROG Phone 7雙雙擠進前十名，回收漲幅分別高達17%與23%，傑昇通信指出，在血統純正的電競手機市場漸趨小眾的背景下，具備16GB記憶體與高效能散熱架構的歷代電競機王，已成為手遊玩家與二手機商眼中的稀缺資產。
從十月份二手機回收行情的變化可看出，高規格硬體配置與大記憶體容量已成為決定舊機殘值的核心分水嶺。特別是十月底回收報價提高、形成新不如舊的奇特現象，反映回收業者趕在雙11購物節與年底換機潮前夕預先囤貨的策略。
傑昇通信坦言，目前新款手機不是定價調漲就是降規開倒車，使這一兩年問世的12GB與16GB大記憶體旗艦機顯得格外超值，成為撐起二手機市場收購熱度的主力，考量舊機回收溢價仰賴檔期備貨動能支撐，加上接連而來的年終購物促銷檔期到來，持有高規舊機的民眾若能及早趁價格高點變現，才能順利鎖住當前的殘值紅利。
paras_en: Global memory and advanced chip prices continue to hover at high levels, forcing new mid‑range phones into a dilemma of either raising prices or compromising specs, which highlights the value‑preserving advantage of high‑spec old flagships. Ahead of the Double‑11 shopping festival, a surge in stockpiling led Jiesheng Communications to release its October 2026 used‑phone resale value ranking. Motorola’s first book‑style large‑fold flagship, the Razr Fold (12GB/256GB), topped the list with a monthly value increase of NT$2,170, pushing its highest resale price to NT$24,620. Notably, every model on the list is equipped with at least 12GB of memory, signalling that used‑phone pricing has entered an era dominated by spec scarcity.

Observing the Motorola Razr Fold that captured the top spot this month, Jiesheng Communications notes that the price surge is concentrated on well‑conditioned flagship devices with high‑end hardware. Since its launch in June, the Razr Fold has had limited circulation, and used‑phone buyers raised purchase prices sharply in October to meet market demand for large‑fold phones. This not only made the Razr Fold the resale value champion but also shattered the stereotype that foldable phones depreciate quickly; based on the end‑September purchase price of NT$22,450, a consumer selling in October would receive an extra NT$2,170 in residual value.

Benefiting from premium imaging and foldable premiums are the two major brands Vivo and Xiaomi, which together occupy six slots on the list. This year’s Vivo X300 Ultra and Xiaomi 17 Ultra take second and third places, each adding more than NT$1,500 in a single month—a near‑10% increase—showing that flagship phones with top‑tier optics and large storage still possess the strongest asset moat in an inflationary environment.

Jiesheng Communications says that historically used‑phone purchase prices were driven by "brand halo," but during the year‑end upgrade season, buyers are willing to raise acquisition costs to snap up high‑spec scarce units rather than over‑discount low‑end inventory.

Beyond top‑tier flagships showing resilience, mid‑range light flagships and cross‑generation gaming phones also saw remarkable price rebounds in October. After Xiaomi launched the new 17T Pro in October, its pricing strategy created a spill‑over effect, lifting the brand’s overall resale prices by 12% in a single month and propelling the previous‑generation Xiaomi 15T Pro 5G to a staggering 24% jump, the highest increase on the entire list.

Worth noting is ASUS’s gaming series: the ROG Phone 8 and ROG Phone 7, released two years ago, both cracked the top ten, with resale gains of 17% and 23% respectively. Jiesheng points out that as the pure‑line gaming phone market becomes more niche, generations of gaming flagships equipped with 16GB RAM and high‑efficiency cooling have become scarce assets prized by mobile‑game players and used‑phone traders alike.

The October used‑phone resale trends reveal that high‑spec hardware and large memory capacities have become the key dividing line for residual values. Especially the late‑October price hikes, creating a rare “new‑is‑worse‑than‑old” phenomenon, reflect buyers stockpiling ahead of the Double‑11 festival and the year‑end upgrade wave.

Jiesheng admits that new phones are either priced higher or downgraded in specs, making the 12GB and 16GB flagship models released in the past couple of years especially cost‑effective and the main drivers of used‑phone market activity. Since old‑phone premium values rely on stock‑building momentum and the upcoming year‑end sales periods, owners of high‑spec older devices who cash out early at peak prices can lock in the current residual‑value dividend.

美股感恩節前夕上演驚天大逆轉！儘管美國通膨數據仍具黏性，加上川普政府擬對14個貿易夥伴祭出新一輪關稅措施，市場對利率政策及AI產業前景的疑慮升溫，科技股開盤遭遇沉重賣壓，道瓊工業指數盤中一度重挫逾1,100點，不過隨著逢低買盤進場，資金轉向傳統產業及大型權值股，終場道瓊反而上漲164點，展現美股市場強勁承接力道。從主要指數來看，道瓊工業指數終場上漲164點，標普500指數與那斯達克指數同步收低，費城半導體指數下跌約0.6%，顯示科技股賣壓尚未完全消退。個股方面，(NVDA-US)輝達下跌3.9%，(MU-US)美光下挫約4.5%，市場逐漸淡化黃仁勳回任執行長帶來的短線利多，重新檢視AI資本支出規模、企業融資成本及產業競爭風險。相較之下，(IBM-US)IBM、(CRM-US)Salesforce等傳統科技股表現相對強勢，成為支撐道瓊收紅的重要力量。值得注意的是，美國10月個人消費支出PCE物價指數月增0.3%、年增3.8%，核心PCE年增3.3%，略高於市場原先預估，反映通膨降溫速度仍不如預期，市場持續關注聯準會後續利率政策，此外，標普全球評級因管理與公司治理風險升高，將輝達信用評等列入負向觀察，也使AI龍頭短線面臨額外壓力，不過，市場並非全面看空，逢低承接力量仍在，顯示資金正從追逐題材轉向重新評估企業基本面與獲利能力。
台股今日強勢反彈，盤中一度大漲逾1200點，終場加權指數收在39151點，上漲956點，漲幅2.5%，成交量達8174億元，台股今日出現反彈格局，指數站穩五日均線大關，加上投信+自營商站在買方，雖然有外資的賣盤，不過逆勢走高，顯示低檔買盤積極進場，不過，短線仍須留意美國利率政策、關稅變數及外資期現貨動向，指數在年線附近仍可能出現反覆震盪，後續行情將由權值股與具備實質獲利成長的個股主導。

展望後市，12月將迎來AI產業重要觀察窗口，包括輝達GTC相關活動，以及特斯拉無人駕駛計程車Cybercab預計自12月4日起展開全台巡迴展示，首站規劃於台北信義區登場，相關AI應用與自動駕駛發展可望持續吸引市場關注，操作策略上，建議維持選股不選市，聚焦兩大主軸：第一，AI基礎建設升級，鎖定晶圓代工、ASIC、散熱、電源、PCB及光通訊等供應鏈；第二，先進製程持續擴產所帶動的半導體設備與關鍵零組件，掌握中長期產業成長機會。

權值股方面，(2330-TW)台積電，下跌0.23%，收在2145元，積極擴大美國先進製程布局，擬投資216.55億美元赴德州布拉索斯郡興建至少一座先進晶圓廠，鎖定2奈米及更先進製程，預計2027年動工、2031年商轉，此案若順利推進，將成為台積電在美國第二座先進半導體製造園區，預估創造逾2,099個就業機會，後續仍須取得德州租稅優惠核准，若投資落地，將有助深化美國市場布局，並提升先進製程長期競爭優勢 ；

(2317-TW)鴻海，上漲4.84%，收在216.5元，AI伺服器業務持續強勁，宣布2027年AI機櫃訂單已全數訂滿，第四季出貨量可望較第三季成長雙位數，主要客戶涵蓋北美四大CSP，以Google貢獻最大，隨全球AI資料中心投資持續擴大，鴻海與廣達均看好明年伺服器業務維持高成長，雖然記憶體、HBM、企業級SSD及封測產能仍有供應瓶頸，但長期AI需求明確，隨供應鏈擴產及產能逐步到位，有望持續挹注營收，帶動AI伺服器產業成長 ；

(2454-TW)聯發科，上漲1.65%，收在3705元，受惠AI ASIC需求快速升溫，預期2027年AI ASIC市占率可望達15%至20%，相關營收挑戰160億美元，並隨Google TPU世代升級及第二家非中國資料中心ASIC客戶加入，2028年營運有望再添成長動能，此外，聯發科結合輝達 NVLink Fusion技術，將業務版圖延伸至高階AI晶片互連與機櫃級整合，搭配448G SerDes技術布局，有助提升產品競爭力與平均銷售單價，預估2026、2027年EPS分別為72.05元及150.35元，，後續仍須留意客戶集中、產能瓶頸及同業競爭風險。

items.title: 立碁台中路燈汰換案訴訟落幕 與台中市府達成調解可望進帳9937萬元
paras: LED封裝廠立碁(8111-TW)今(26)日公告，與臺中市政府建設局針對臺中市水銀路燈落日計畫汰換工程案訴訟達成調解，雙方於臺灣高等法院臺中分院工程法庭調解成立，臺中市政府建設局同意給付立碁本金加計年息5%之利息，合計共新台幣9937.4萬元，預計將於民國116年2月23日前完成給付。
立碁公告，此次調解標的為臺中市水銀路燈落日計畫汰換工程案第八工程西屯、南屯及中、西區之爭議款項，臺中市政府建設局同意給付本金7017.1萬元，以及自民國107年8月28日起至115年12月23日止之利息2920.2萬元。立碁表示，本次調解結果對公司財務與業務並無重大影響，後續將依調解內容進行款項收取作業。
回顧本案訴訟歷程，繼一審與二審判決後，臺中市政府建設局原預計給付立碁新台幣7711.5萬元及相關法定利息。隨後經最高法院三審判決，廢棄二審判決再給付中之新台幣1274.4萬元本息及該部分訴訟費用，並將全案發回臺灣高等法院臺中分院更一審，最終雙方於更一審階段順利達成調解共識。

paras: 台北股市今(26)日早盤由跌深反彈的電子股帶頭衝鋒，終場大盤上漲956.38點作，收盤報39151.81點，成交值萎縮爲8174.68億元。外資仍站在賣方，單日在集中市場賣超外資賣超491.81億元，本土投信及自營商則以買超對應今天的台股反彈格局。

Foreign investors remained on the sell side, net selling NT$491.81 billion in the spot market, while domestic investment trusts and proprietary traders were net buyers, supporting today’s market rally.

In the foreign exchange market, the New Taiwan dollar closed at NT$32.947 per US dollar on November 26, appreciating by 0.179 NT$, with a transaction volume of US$1.79 billion.
