items.title_en: Strategist Optimistic on US Stock Outlook, S&P 500 Could Reach 10,000 by End‑2027
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，儘管黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US)後，科技股再度重挫，市場也因新一輪關稅疑慮及最新一批偏熱的通膨數據而感到不安，但這些因素並未打消一位策略師對美股做出樂觀、大膽預測的信心。
Federated Hermes全球股票投資長Steve Chiavarone表示，他仍認為標普500指數有機會在2027年底達到1萬點，較目前水準高出40%。這項預測比德意志銀行、滙豐，以及長期看多市場的Yardeni Research創辦人Ed Yardeni近期提出的預測更加樂觀。Yardeni和德銀策略師Binky Chadha對標普500指數的目標價均為9,000點。
Chiavarone坦言，有些人可能認為他的目標過於樂觀，但他強調，這並非盲目樂觀。首先，他目前預估標普500指數2027年和2028年的每股盈餘分別為425美元和490美元，與FactSet統計的市場共識預估423.24美元和495.39美元大致相符。
Chiavarone表示，「我的目標之所以看起來荒謬，唯一原因是過去一個月市場本益比已跌至17倍。」他指出，目前股價反映的是2027年經濟將放緩的預期，但他並不認為這種情況會發生。
他談到，「除非你認為經濟即將陷入衰退，否則本益比不應持續遭到壓縮。」他補充，如果標普500指數明年僅以他預估的2028年每股盈餘為基礎，回升至20倍本益比，指數就有機會達到1萬點。
Chiavarone認為，市場對AI支出即將停滯的擔憂被過度放大。事實上，他表示，2027年資本支出略微放緩，未必是壞事。這可能讓未來幾年的支出更具持續性，也有助於降低市場對所謂「循環融資」疑慮。
這也可能帶動AI晶片成本下降。雖然這對輝達、記憶體大廠美光科技(MU-US)、超微(AMD-US)及其他半導體公司而言，未必是好消息，但Chiavarone表示，這可能讓軟體、網路安全公司及其他優質成長股等AI使用者受惠。
他指出，「晶片股交易最好的時光可能已經過去，但我認為這對AI支出者反而是好事。如果資本支出稍微放緩，價格壓力就會減輕。」
那麼，哪些因素可能讓他的預測落空？Chiavarone表示，科技業獲利成長確實可能比預期更大幅放緩，AI企業也可能出現信用問題，進一步打擊市場信心。但他認為這兩種情境發生的可能性都不高，聯準會(Fed)犯下政策錯誤的風險也不大。
Chiavarone認為，聯準會很可能在12月升息，並可能在2027年初再升息兩次。但他表示，考量到今年第一季伊朗戰爭推升油價，之後通膨年增率的比較基期將逐漸變得有利，屆時通膨數據應會開始改善。
他表示，「聯準會可能停止升息。」他補充，這將有助於市場漲勢擴大。小型股、金融股及其他對利率敏感的股票可能因此受惠。Chiavarone也認為，估值偏低的非必需消費品類股相當具吸引力。他並維持原先看法，認為投資人應開始減碼民生必需品、醫療保健及其他防禦型類股。
沒錯，目前市場看起來確實令人不安。近期股市回檔速度相當快，跌幅也十分顯著。但這可能只是典型的恐慌性賣壓。只要看看VIX恐慌指數就能發現，本月稍早還在15至17左右，，如今已飆升至30左右。
Chiavarone表示，「大家需要先冷靜下來。市場上有很多投資人已經開始動搖。多頭市場通常是在一片自負與狂妄中結束，而不是在不確定與疑慮中落幕。」
這番話或許有道理。華爾街也有一句廣為人知的格言：市場總是在憂慮之牆上攀升。投資人如今正仰望著這道高牆，問題在於，究竟需要什麼條件，才能讓他們重新開始向上攀爬。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that despite Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia (NVDA‑US) triggering another tech‑stock pullback, and market unease over a fresh round of tariff concerns and the latest batch of still‑hot inflation data, those factors have not dampened a strategist’s confidence to make an optimistic, bold forecast for US equities.

Federated Hermes global equities chief Steve Chiavarone said he still believes the S&P 500 has a chance to hit 10,000 points by the end of 2027, about 40% above current levels. This outlook is more upbeat than recent forecasts from Deutsche Bank, HSBC and Yardeni Research founder Ed Yardeni, who both target the index at 9,000 points.

Chiavarone admitted some may view his target as overly optimistic, but he stressed it is not blind optimism. He currently estimates S&P 500 earnings per share of $425 for 2027 and $490 for 2028, roughly in line with FactSet’s consensus forecasts of $423.24 and $495.39 respectively.

He explained, “My target looks absurd only because the market P/E ratio has slipped to 17 over the past month.” He noted that today’s prices reflect expectations of a slowing economy in 2027, a scenario he does not believe will materialise.

He added, “Unless you think the economy is about to fall into recession, the P/E ratio should not keep being compressed.” If the index were to rebound to a 20‑times P/E next year based on his 2028 earnings estimate, it could reach the 10,000‑point level.

Chiavarone argued that worries about AI spending stalling are overstated. In fact, a modest slowdown in 2027 capital expenditures may not be a bad thing, as it could make spending more sustainable in the years ahead and ease concerns about so‑called “circular financing.”

That could also drive AI‑chip costs down. While that may not be welcome news for Nvidia, memory giant Micron Technology (MU‑US), AMD (AMD‑US) and other semiconductor firms, Chiavarone said it could benefit software, cybersecurity firms and other high‑growth stocks that use AI.
He noted, “The best trading days for chip stocks may be behind us, but I think that’s actually good for AI spenders. A slight slowdown in capex eases price pressure.”

What could derail his forecast? Chiavarone said tech profit growth could slow more than expected and AI companies might face credit issues, both of which could dent confidence. He believes the likelihood of either scenario is low and that the Fed is unlikely to make a policy mistake.

Chiavarone expects the Fed to raise rates in December and possibly twice more in early 2027. He added that, given the oil‑price spike from the Iran war in Q1, the base for year‑over‑year inflation will become more favorable, allowing inflation data to improve over time.

He said, “The Fed may stop raising rates,” which would help broaden market gains. Small‑caps, financials and other rate‑sensitive stocks could benefit. He also finds undervalued consumer‑discretionary stocks attractive and maintains his view that investors should start trimming exposure to staples, healthcare and other defensive sectors.

Indeed, the market looks uneasy now. Recent pullbacks have been swift and steep, but that may simply be typical panic selling. A glance at the VIX shows it was around 15‑17 earlier this month and has now surged to roughly 30.
Chiavarone warned, “Everyone needs to calm down first. Many investors are already wavering. Bull markets usually end in a wave of hubris and overconfidence, not in uncertainty and doubt.”

That may be true. Wall Street has a well‑known saying: markets always climb the wall of worry. Investors are now staring at that high wall, and the question is what conditions are needed for them to start climbing upward again.

items.title: 滙豐看好2027年：AI震盪反而創造進場甜蜜點
items.title_en: HSBC bullish on 2027: AI turbulence instead creates a sweet entry point
paras: 對投資人而言，現在似乎不是特別有利的時刻：通膨持續頑強攀升，聯準會(Fed)似乎幾乎確定將再次升息。與此同時，人工智慧(AI)交易正讓市場劇烈震盪，如今關稅議題也再度浮上檯面。但滙豐控股(HSBC)策略師卻認為，股市實際上可能正處於一個難得的甜蜜點。
滙豐新興市場及全球股票策略主管Alastair Pinder表示，近期由AI造成的全球股市波動，實際上已改善2027年的風險報酬比。
他認為，股市雖然已從高點大幅回落，但實際情況只是股票變得更便宜，而非陷入持續下跌的漩渦。
Pinder寫道：「若要讓這波跌勢演變成更持久的空頭市場，導致估值下修的壓力就必須大幅升高，包括市場對AI變現能力的疑慮、債券殖利率上升及聯準會(Fed)立場更加鷹派，以及能源價格再度帶來壓力。我們預期情況將朝相反方向發展。」

超大型雲端業者現金流可望觸底 企業導入AI有望提升生產力

儘管許多投資人擔心大型科技公司為建置AI基礎設施而大規模舉債，Pinder預料，美國超大型雲端服務業者的自由現金流將在2027年上半年觸底，之後隨著雲端營收預估加速成長、資本支出放緩而回升。
此外，隨著更多企業採用AI，應該會開始看到生產力提升的實際證據。
雖然市場幾乎篤定Fed下個月將升息，但目前市場已反映Fed至2027年年中累計升息65個基點的預期，「導致鷹派意外出現的門檻很高」。此外，能源價格的基期效應自明年3月起將轉趨有利，可能減輕通膨壓力。
他也指出，從歷史經驗來看，在Fed升息幅度較溫和的緊縮周期中，標普500指數在前12個月平均上漲16%。
與此同時，股票估值「開始反映最糟情境……全球科技股估值目前隱含的中期EPS成長率接近零，遠低於2025年年中約25%的水準」。
美國及國際股市近期的跌勢，似乎與2027年企業獲利仍可能保持穩健的情況不相符。目前市場共識預估，標普500指數成分股明年每股盈餘將年增17%。
換句話說，在美國企業獲利展現韌性、股票估值相對溫和的情況下，隨著AI投資放緩、生產力提升效益逐漸顯現，股市在2027年可能再度走揚。
不過，凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)資深市場經濟學家James Reilly提醒，市場共識預估往往落後於實際情況，歷史經驗也顯示，企業獲利預估很可能下修。他寫道：「即使只是對分析師的獲利預期進行溫和下修，美股看起來仍相對昂貴。」
儘管如此，Pinder對經濟成長前景仍較為樂觀。考量美國企業獲利成長前景強勁，他對美股維持加碼，至於新興市場在近期遭遇賣壓之後，估值已降至過低水準，因此也予以加碼。他對歐股維持中立，對日股則採取減碼立場。
Pinder說：「我們偏好資產負債表穩健的企業，尤其是半導體製造商及超大型雲端服務業者。隨著經濟成長維持韌性，我們也看好景氣循環股，除了科技股之外，金融、工業及原物料類股也都維持加碼。」
paras_en: For investors, now does not seem like a particularly favorable moment: inflation remains stubbornly high, the Fed appears almost certain to raise rates again, AI trading is causing market volatility, and tariff issues have resurfaced. Yet HSBC strategists believe the equity market may actually be at a rare sweet spot.

Alastair Pinder, head of emerging markets and global equity strategy at HSBC, said that the recent AI‑driven volatility in global equity markets has actually improved the risk‑return profile for 2027.
He believes that although the market has pulled back sharply from its highs, the reality is simply that stocks have become cheaper, not that they are caught in a persistent down‑trend.

Pinder wrote: “For this pull‑back to turn into a longer‑lasting bear market, the pressure to cut valuations would have to rise sharply, including doubts about AI’s monetisation, rising bond yields, a more hawkish Fed stance, and renewed energy‑price pressures. We expect the opposite to happen.”

Despite many investors worrying that large tech firms are taking on massive debt to build AI infrastructure, Pinder expects the free cash flow of U.S. hyperscale cloud providers to bottom in the first half of 2027 and then recover as cloud revenue forecasts accelerate and capital spending slows.
Moreover, as more companies adopt AI, we should start seeing tangible evidence of productivity gains.

While the market is almost certain the Fed will raise rates next month, it has already priced in expectations of a cumulative 65‑basis‑point hike by mid‑2027, making the threshold for an unexpected hawkish shift very high. In addition, the base‑effect of energy prices is set to turn favourable from March next year, potentially easing inflation pressures.
He also noted that historically, during periods of relatively moderate Fed tightening, the S&P 500 has risen an average of 16% over the first 12 months.

At the same time, stock valuations are “starting to reflect the worst‑case scenario… the implied mid‑term EPS growth rate for global tech stocks is now near zero, far below the roughly 25% level seen around mid‑2025.”

The recent declines in U.S. and international equity markets seem at odds with the view that corporate earnings could remain robust in 2027. The consensus now expects S&P 500 component companies to post a 17% year‑over‑year earnings per share increase next year.

In other words, with resilient U.S. corporate earnings and relatively moderate valuations, combined with a slowdown in AI spending and gradually materialising productivity benefits, the market could rally again in 2027.

However, James Reilly, senior market economist at Capital Economics, warned that consensus forecasts often lag reality and historically earnings forecasts are likely to be revised down. He wrote: “Even a modest downgrade of analysts’ earnings expectations would make U.S. equities still look relatively expensive.”

Nevertheless, Pinder remains more optimistic about growth prospects. Given the strong earnings outlook for U.S. companies, he maintains a net‑add stance on U.S. equities, and after recent selling pressure has pushed emerging‑market valuations to overly low levels, he is also adding there. He stays neutral on European stocks and is reducing exposure to Japanese equities.

Pinder said: “We prefer companies with strong balance sheets, especially semiconductor manufacturers and hyperscale cloud providers. With economic growth remaining resilient, we are also bullish on cyclical stocks – beyond tech, we are adding to financials, industrials and materials.”

items.title: 「AI股神」Q3虧65%！槓桿押注AI股一度瀕臨崩潰 前三季仍賺88.5%
items.title_en: “AI Stock God” Q3 Losses 65% as Leveraged AI Bets Nearly Crashed, Yet Still Up 88.5% in First Three Quarters
paras: 外媒披露，曾被市場奉為「AI股神」、25歲前OpenAI研究員Leopold Aschenbrenner旗下Situational Awareness基金，第3季淨值暴跌65%，主因是高度槓桿押注7月曾讓該基金幾乎崩潰的人工智慧(AI)股。但今年來至9月底的收益仍達88.5%，顯示上半年累積可觀獲利。
Situational Awareness在華爾街日報(WSJ)取得的投資人信函中揭露報酬。值得注意的是，信中提及的第3季績效，並未反映10月AI的劇烈震盪：當時AI企業估值受到市場檢視，與AI基建熱潮相關的股票也劇烈震盪。
Aschenbrenner在信中寫道，Anthropic(ANT-US)11月19日上市後，Situational Awareness的投資組合約有70%配置於上市股票，另外30%則投資於未上市企業。Anthropic占了該基金未上市企業投資部位中最大的比重。
報導指出，該基金仍可能調整投資組合、降低對Anthropic的配置比重，但Aschenbrenner表示，以首次公開發行(IPO)價格而言，基金仍「高度看好」Anthropic。
Aschenbrenner在信中表示，近期市場動盪讓他學到教訓，因此正採取更審慎的風險管理方式。根據報導，他向投資人說：「波動可以接受；但即使我們完全看錯，也絕不能承擔足以威脅基金生存的風險。」

7月AI市場恐慌 曾導致保證金追繳

今年7月，由於市場短暫出現對AI產業的恐慌情緒，並迅速蔓延至全球市場，銀行因此對Situational Awareness發出追繳保證金通知，使該基金一度瀕臨崩潰，成為AI交易劇烈波動的代表案例。
最終，該公司將公開股票投資組合中的一大部分出售給Ken Griffin旗下的城堡證券(Citadel)。
Aschenbrenner以自己2024年撰寫、在網路上廣泛流傳的一篇文章為旗下基金命名，並將投資重心放在他認為將受惠於AI革命的企業，很快就以運用槓桿放大報酬及風險的投資方式聞名。
paras_en: Foreign media disclosed that the Situational Awareness fund, once hailed by the market as the “AI Stock God” and run by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner before he turned 25, saw its net asset value plunge 65% in Q3, mainly because of a highly leveraged bet on AI stocks that almost caused the fund to collapse in July. Nevertheless, its returns through the end of September this year still reached 88.5%, showing a sizable profit accumulated in the first half of the year.

The fund’s performance was revealed in an investor letter obtained by the Wall Street Journal (WSJ). Notably, the Q3 results mentioned in the letter do not reflect the severe turbulence in AI that began in October, when AI company valuations came under market scrutiny and stocks tied to the AI‑infrastructure boom swung wildly.

Aschenbrenner wrote in the letter that after Anthropic (ANT‑US) went public on November 19, roughly 70% of Situational Awareness’s portfolio was allocated to listed equities, with the remaining 30% invested in private companies. Anthropic made up the largest share of the fund’s private‑company holdings.

The report noted that the fund may still rebalance its portfolio and reduce its exposure to Anthropic, but Aschenbrenner said that, based on the IPO price, the fund remains “very bullish” on Anthropic.

Aschenbrenner said in the letter that recent market volatility taught him a lesson, prompting a more cautious risk‑management approach. He told investors, “Volatility is acceptable; but even if we are completely wrong, we must never take risks that could threaten the fund’s survival.”

July AI‑market panic triggered a margin call. In July this year, a brief wave of panic over the AI sector spread globally, prompting banks to issue a margin‑call notice to Situational Awareness, pushing the fund to the brink of collapse and making it a textbook example of the extreme swings in AI trading.
Eventually, the firm sold a large portion of its public‑stock holdings to Ken Griffin’s Citadel Securities.

Aschenbrenner named the fund after an article he wrote in 2024 that went viral online, and he focused the fund’s investments on companies he believes will benefit from the AI revolution, quickly gaining a reputation for using leverage to amplify both returns and risk.

items.title: 避險基金連五週砍倉、ETF空單一週飆19%！高盛：快錢拋售近尾聲 基準情境下12月初止穩
items.title_en: Hedge Funds Cut Positions for Five Weeks, ETF Shorts Surge 19% in One Week! Goldman Sachs: Fast Money Sell‑off Nearing End, Stabilization Expected Early December in Base Scenario
paras: 全球股市劇烈震盪下，華爾街正上演「快錢逃、慢錢扛」的極端分化。高盛(GS-US)大宗經紀業務洞察與分析共同主管Vincent Lin在本週播客中說：「避險基金客戶已連5週削減股票曝險部位，上週更轉向主動加空，ETF空單單週跳升19個百分點，創過去十年第三大單週增幅；個股、指數期貨同步加空，反映機構情緒脆弱、不確定性升高。」
根據高盛統計的1001檔避險基金持倉數據，亞馬遜、Meta、微軟跟輝達等「最青睞50股」今年至上周四(19日)累計下跌3%，同期標普500上漲6%；過去六個月相對大盤落後程度，創20年來最大紀錄之一。前十大重倉股佔投資組合中位數高達70%，第三季擁擠度創歷史新高，集中持倉放大回撤。」
結果是獲利蒸發：股票多空策略今年報酬率從年中約17%降到週一(23日)約7%。基金不願再冒險，板塊上撤出高β科技、轉進金融、公用事業、工業，動量因子部位降至2023年以來最低；空頭則瞄準房市、住宅營建等敏感消費板塊。
主動型避險基金去槓桿後，系統性策略壓力未釋放完。高盛估算，CTA等宏觀系統策略上週已賣出約700億美元全球股票，未來一週還將賣約1000億美元；美股淨部位轉空，短中期趨勢訊號幾乎全轉負。基準情境下，拋售可望12月初止穩，若盤勢反彈，空頭回補會加快。
形成鮮明對比的是「慢錢」按兵不動。過去一個月，ETF與共同基金合計吸金約1500億美元，退休帳戶、401(k)、家戶資金仍在逢跌加碼。對此Lin說道：「快錢接近多年低點，慢錢部位仍相對偏高。」
AI敘事轉折是根本原因。客戶越來越認為，AI基礎建設回報最豐厚階段可能已過，交易從「算力擴張」切到「變現與ROI」。
隨著年底將近，基金轉向資本保全，等價格企穩才肯加碼，企業回購與家戶流入，成為年底大盤最主要的承接力量。
paras_en: Global equity markets have been wildly volatile, and Wall Street is witnessing an extreme split between “fast money fleeing” and “slow money holding.” Vincent Lin, co‑head of Goldman Sachs’ (GS‑US) Global Prime Brokerage Insights and Analytics, said in this week’s podcast that hedge‑fund clients have trimmed equity exposure for five consecutive weeks and last week shifted to actively adding shorts. ETF short positions jumped 19 percentage points in a single week, the third‑largest weekly increase in the past decade; individual stocks and index futures were also shorted, reflecting fragile institutional sentiment and rising uncertainty.

Based on Goldman’s data covering 1,001 hedge‑fund holdings, the “top‑50 favorite” stocks such as Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and Nvidia have fallen a cumulative 3% year‑to‑date through Thursday (the 19th), while the S&P 500 has risen 6% over the same period. Over the past six months their performance relative to the broader market has lagged to one of the worst levels in the past 20 years. The ten largest holdings make up about 70% of the median portfolio, and third‑quarter concentration hit a historic high, amplifying drawdowns from concentrated positions.

The result is evaporating profits: equity long‑short strategies have seen returns fall from roughly 17% mid‑year to about 7% as of Monday (the 23rd). Funds are unwilling to take further risk, pulling out of high‑beta tech and moving into financials, utilities and industrials, with momentum‑factor exposure dropping to its lowest level since 2023. Short sellers are targeting housing, residential construction and other sensitive consumer sectors.

After active hedge funds deleveraged, systemic strategy pressure remains. Goldman estimates that macro‑systematic strategies such as CTAs sold roughly $70 billion of global equities last week and will sell about $100 billion more in the coming week; net U.S. equity positions have turned short, and short‑term trend signals are almost entirely negative. In a base‑case scenario, the sell‑off is expected to stabilize by early December, though a market rebound would accelerate short covering.

In stark contrast, “slow money” has stayed put. Over the past month, ETFs and mutual funds together attracted about $150 billion of inflows, while retirement accounts, 401(k)s and household cash continued to add on dips. Lin noted, “Fast money is near multi‑year lows, while slow‑money positions remain relatively high.”

The AI narrative shift is the underlying driver. Clients increasingly believe that the most lucrative phase of AI infrastructure returns may be over, and trading focus has moved from “computing power expansion” to “monetization and ROI.”

As year‑end approaches, funds are shifting to capital preservation, waiting for prices to stabilize before adding more. Corporate buybacks and household inflows become the main drivers supporting the market in the final months of the year.

items.title: AI贏家再洗牌！晶片股遭拋售、軟體股接棒  市場從「算力信仰」轉向「護城河篩選」
items.title_en: AI Winners Reshuffle Again! Chip Stocks Sold Off, Software Stocks Take the Lead as Market Shifts from “Compute Power Faith” to “Moat Screening”
paras: 今年11月以來，科技類股遭遇猛烈拋售，但軟體股相對未受衝擊，此次拋售主要集中在半導體股票上，而直到不久前，這些股票還是投資人競相追捧的對象。
2026年這場AI行情正上演一場內部大輪動，上半年還被資金瘋搶的半導體股，進入下半年成為拋售重災區，而一度被宣判「將被AI消滅」的軟體股，反而守住跌幅、跑贏大盤。
今年迄今，標普500(INX)的軟體與半導體成分股皆小幅下跌，但軟體股明顯抗跌，那斯達克100(NDX)則因晶片權重過高，近期一度墜入熊市區間，較高點回撤逾20%。
市場情緒反轉快得像照鏡子。德意志銀行跨資產策略主管Max Uleer說：「現在市場對半導體的情緒，跟六到九個月前對軟體的情緒一模一樣。」
今年初，Anthropic(ANT-US) 推出法律、銷售、行銷自動化工具，市場極度擔心「AI殺死SaaS」，軟體股被瘋砍，避險基金最愛的交易是「超配晶片、低配軟體」。如今，美國期中選舉後民主黨掌控國會，市場擔心資料中心擴建、AI監管與資本回報受限，晶片股成為提款機。
巴克莱銀行EMEA股票資本市場共同主管Lawrence Jamieson指出，軟體敘事已從「被顛覆」轉向「分辨真贏家」。擁有專有數據、深度客戶黏著與領域知識的公司，AI難以輕易複製。
Orbis Investments全球股票策略師本Ben Preston也說，軟體疲軟反而給出「便宜買進好公司」的投資機會。
反彈高度選擇性：網安與數據基建最強，CrowdStrike、Palo Alto今年來分別大漲72%與89%；微軟靠雲端與企業滲透止穩，但 Salesforce、Adobe跌逾 30%，Intuit重挫 58%，市場不再為「AI概念」埋單，只認可能變現、有護城河的標的。
道富託管數據顯示，機構近期大賣晶片、回補軟體。Man Group策略師Kristina Hooper說：「市場其實仍不知道AI最終誰贏誰輸，今年本質上是場猜謎遊戲。」
法巴銀行高收益部門主管Stan Hartman也說，現在融資環境雖改善，但投資人要求企業證明收入可持續。
這輪切換的底層邏輯是AI投資從「買算力無腦成長」進入「看回報、看現金流、看護城河」的第二階段。半導體不是沒需求，而是估值與預期跑太快；軟體也不是全數復活，而是優勝劣汰。
短期看，CTA量化基金與波動基金仍可能壓抑反彈；中長期看，AI交易沒結束，只是換賽道：誰能把手上數據與客戶網絡轉成AI 收入，誰才是下一個贏家。
paras_en: Since November this year, technology stocks have faced a sharp sell‑off, but software stocks have been relatively unscathed. The sell‑off has been concentrated in semiconductor equities, which until recently were the darlings of investors.

In 2026 the AI rally is undergoing an internal rotation. Semiconductor stocks that were hoarded in the first half are now the hardest hit in the second half, while software stocks once warned they would be “killed by AI” have held their ground and outperformed the broader market.

To date this year, both software and semiconductor components of the S&P 500 (INX) have slipped slightly, but software has shown clear resilience. The Nasdaq‑100 (NDX), weighted heavily toward chips, has even slipped into bear‑market territory, retreating more than 20% from its recent highs.

Market sentiment is flipping as quickly as a mirror image. Max Uleer, head of cross‑asset strategy at Deutsche Bank, said, “The current market mood on semiconductors is exactly the same as the mood on software six to nine months ago.”

Earlier this year Anthropic (ANT‑US) launched legal, sales and marketing automation tools, sparking fears that “AI will kill SaaS.” Software stocks were brutally cut and hedge funds favored “overweight chips, underweight software.” After the U.S. mid‑term elections left Congress in Democratic hands, concerns over data‑center expansion, AI regulation and constrained capital returns have turned chip stocks into cash‑cows.

Lawrence Jamieson, co‑head of EMEA equity capital markets at Barclays, noted that the software narrative has shifted from “being disrupted” to “identifying the true winners.” Companies with proprietary data, deep customer stickiness and domain expertise are hard for AI to replicate.
Ben Preston, global equity strategist at Orbis Investments, added that the software slowdown actually creates “cheap buying opportunities for good companies.”

The rebound is highly selective: cyber‑security and data‑infrastructure leaders are strongest, with CrowdStrike and Palo Alto soaring 72% and 89% respectively this year; Microsoft steadies on cloud and enterprise penetration, while Salesforce and Adobe have fallen over 30% and Intuit plunged 58%, as the market stops paying for mere “AI hype” and only backs targets with moat potential and monetisation prospects.

State Street custodial data show institutions have recently sold chips and re‑bought software. Kristina Hooper, strategist at Man Group, said, “The market still doesn’t know who will ultimately win or lose in AI; this year is essentially a guessing game.”
Stan Hartman, head of high‑yield at BNP Paribas, also said that although financing conditions have improved, investors now demand companies prove their revenue streams are sustainable.

The underlying logic of this rotation is that AI investing is moving from “buying compute power with blind growth expectations” to a second phase of “looking at returns, cash flow and moats.” Semiconductors still have demand, but valuations and expectations have run ahead of fundamentals; software isn’t fully revived, but the weak are being weeded out.

In the short term, CTA quant funds and volatility funds may still dampen any bounce. In the medium to long term, AI trading isn’t over—it’s simply changing tracks: whoever can turn their data and customer networks into AI revenue will be the next winner.

items.title: OpenAI內部模型挑戰57年數學難題 矩陣乘法「速度極限」指向2.25
items.title_en: OpenAI internal model challenges 57-year math problem, matrix multiplication “speed limit” points to 2.25
paras: 從AI訓練到天氣預報，都離不開矩陣乘法。這項運算理論上最快能有多快？OpenAI在11月24日發布的111頁預印本中表示，其內部模型提出證明，指出矩陣乘法的指數恰好是9/4，也就是2.25。
若證明成立，這道研究了57年的難題將有明確答案，學界長期探討的「指數可能降至2」猜想也將被推翻。
矩陣可以看成一張數字表。兩個矩陣相乘時，要算出結果中的一個數字，得從第一張表橫取一排數字，再從第二張表縱取一排，把對應位置的數字逐一相乘後加總。
以兩個1,000乘以1,000的矩陣為例，結果共有100萬個數字，每個數字又各需1,000次乘法，合計得做10億次乘法。
按這種課本上的算法，矩陣邊長增加為兩倍，乘法次數就增至八倍，因為運算量隨邊長的三次方成長。這裡的「3」就是指數。
對需要處理大型矩陣的電腦來說，指數哪怕只降一點，隨著矩陣愈來愈大，省下的運算也愈可觀。
1969年，數學家斯特拉森發現，兩個2乘以2的矩陣相乘，原本需要八次乘法，改變計算方式後，只用七次就能得到相同結果。
單看這張小表，只省下一次乘法，但把大矩陣拆成小區塊，反覆套用同一個技巧，就能把指數從3降下來。
此後，數學家與電腦科學家不斷改良演算法，到2026年8月，已知最佳指數上界已降至約2.3712。學界之所以關注指數能否降至2，原因在於兩個邊長為n的方陣相乘，光是寫出答案，就有n平方個數字。
算出整張表所需的運算量，有沒有可能只比寫出答案多一點？這正是長年來懸而未決的問題。
OpenAI在10月先提出一種方法，主張可將矩陣乘法的指數壓低至2.25。這回答了「目前能算多快」，但仍留下另一個可能：未來若有人設計出不同的算法，紀錄或許還能再往下修。
11月24日的預印本進一步主張，2.25同時也是下界，任何演算法都無法取得更低的指數。若論證成立，能做到的最佳成績與理論下限將落在同一個數字上。這也是2.25被稱為矩陣乘法「最終速度極限」的原因。
矩陣乘法廣泛用於AI訓練、科學模擬、天氣預報與電影特效。不過，指數描述的是矩陣規模持續擴大時，運算量增加的速度，無法直接換算成一支手機或一次AI訓練能快上多少。這套算法要在極大的矩陣上才有機會展現優勢。
對實際應用而言，下一道難題，是讓理論上省下的運算，真正縮短電腦執行所需的時間。
paras_en: From AI training to weather forecasting, matrix multiplication is indispensable. How fast can this operation theoretically be? In a 111‑page preprint released on November 24, OpenAI says its internal model provides a proof that the exponent of matrix multiplication is exactly 9/4, i.e., 2.25.
If the proof holds, a 57‑year‑old open problem would finally have a definitive answer, and the long‑standing conjecture that the exponent could drop to 2 would be disproved.

A matrix can be viewed as a table of numbers. To compute a single entry of the product of two matrices, one takes a row from the first table and a column from the second, multiplies the corresponding entries pairwise, and sums the results.
For two 1,000‑by‑1,000 matrices, the product contains one million entries, each requiring 1,000 multiplications, for a total of one billion multiplications.
With the textbook algorithm, doubling the matrix dimension multiplies the number of operations by eight, because the work grows with the cube of the dimension. That “3” is the exponent.
For computers that handle huge matrices, even a slight reduction in the exponent saves a substantial amount of computation as the matrices grow larger.
In 1969, mathematician Strassen discovered that multiplying two 2‑by‑2 matrices, which naïvely needs eight multiplications, can be done with only seven by changing the computation method.
While this saves only one multiplication for a tiny matrix, applying the same trick recursively to large matrices can lower the exponent from 3.

Since then, mathematicians and computer scientists have continually improved algorithms; by August 2026 the best known upper bound on the exponent had fallen to about 2.3712. Researchers focus on whether the exponent can reach 2 because multiplying two n‑by‑n matrices produces n² output numbers.

The question is whether the total work to compute the whole table can be made only a little more than the work needed just to write down the n² answers—a problem that has remained unresolved for decades.

OpenAI first proposed a method in October claiming to push the exponent down to 2.25. This answered “how fast we can compute today,” but left open the possibility that a different algorithm could lower the bound further.

The November 24 preprint goes further, asserting that 2.25 is also a lower bound—no algorithm can achieve a smaller exponent. If the proof is correct, the best achievable performance and the theoretical limit coincide, which is why 2.25 is called the matrix multiplication “ultimate speed limit.”

Matrix multiplication is widely used in AI training, scientific simulation, weather forecasting, and movie special effects. However, the exponent describes how the computational cost grows as matrix size increases and cannot be directly translated into how much faster a phone or a single AI training run will be. The advantage of the algorithm only manifests on very large matrices.
In practice, the next challenge is to turn the theoretical savings into actual reductions in wall‑clock time for computers.

paras: 2026年11月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股25日早盤受AI股賣壓、通膨升溫與美國擬加徵關稅拖累，午後收復大半失土。那斯達克綜合指數一度重挫4.6%，終場跌幅縮至0.62%；標普500指數盤中最多跌3.2%，收盤跌0.25%。道瓊工業指數則由跌轉漲，收盤守住5萬點。

paras_en: On the morning of November 25, U.S. equities were weighed down by selling pressure in AI stocks, rising inflation and a proposed U.S. tariff increase. By the afternoon the market had recovered most of the losses. The Nasdaq Composite briefly fell 4.6% before narrowing its decline to 0.62% at the close; the S&P 500 slipped as much as 3.2% intraday and ended down 0.25%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average turned from a loss to a gain, closing just above the 50,000‑point threshold.

NVIDIA (NVDA-US) tumbled during the session and closed down 3.9%; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 7% intraday before narrowing to a 0.6% loss at the close. AI firm Anthropic (ANT-US) opened lower but rallied to finish roughly 1% higher. Jensen Huang returned to the CEO chair at NVIDIA on Monday, initially boosting AI stocks, but NVIDIA then posted two consecutive days of declines.

Compute‑rental provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) slid more than 10% during the session, ending near its opening level, while its bonds did not follow suit. Tradeweb data show that yields on CoreWeave’s 2031 bonds rose to nearly 18%. As the stock regained lost ground, bond investors continued to demand higher compensation.

U.S. personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index for October rose 3.8% year‑over‑year, above September’s 3.6%, with core PCE up 3.3% annually. Third‑quarter real GDP annualized growth was revised up from an initial 3.4% to 4.3%. The data reinforced market expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December. items.title: 華爾街罕見出現多空對決 同一家研究機構分析師對Anthropic股價看法分歧
items.title_en: Rare Bull‑Bear Clash on Wall Street: Analysts from Same Research Firm Diverge on Anthropic Stock
paras: 華爾街同一家研究機構的兩名股票分析師，罕見對市場當紅個股Anthropic(ANT-US)上市後的股價走勢提出截然不同的看法。一人認為股價具有長期投資吸引力，另一人則因資料中心融資及長期商業需求疑慮，建議放空。
Hedgeye風險管理公司通訊與軟體分析師Andrew Freedman，自Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)以來便陸續發布相關研究報告。他周三(25日)表示，目前股價水準對長期投資人而言具有吸引力。
但他的同事、Hedgeye全球科技分析師Felix Wang，周二卻發布報告，建議客戶放空Anthropic股票。
Wang發布看法後，Freedman隨即在社群媒體發文，與這項建議劃清界線，表示自己「並未參與促成這項決定的研究或相關過程」。
Wang看空的理由，在於Anthropic仰賴資料中心提供算力，但AI設施取得融資的難度正日益升高，加上市場對Anthropic模型的長期商業需求存有疑慮。
Freedman則看好Anthropic未來有機會成為企業界的新一代作業系統，以及短期需求強勁所釋出的訊號。
Wang預期Anthropic股價將跌至59美元，Freedman則給予92美元的合理價值目標。Anthropic周三收在每股82.79美元。
同一家研究機構內部出現多空不同調，反映市場對人工智慧(AI)顛覆性潛力，以及Anthropic在其中所扮演角色的估值，存在更廣泛的分歧。這也凸顯該股的爭議性：Anthropic上市後估值一度飆升至2兆美元，隨後大幅回落。股價周三一度跌破74美元，之後反彈至約83美元的IPO價格附近。

同一機構分析師罕見唱反調 多空看法各有依據

過去也曾出現同一家銀行內部不同團隊得出相反結論的情況，例如2023年摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)的策略師與投資組合經理人，對整體股市前景便提出不同看法。
不過，華爾街研究機構通常會讓研究團隊形成共識，尤其是針對個別股票。Hedgeye是一家獨立研究機構，Freedman是負責追蹤Anthropic的首席分析師，但Anthropic業務範圍廣泛，也涉及Wang所研究的產業領域。Freedman的看法較接近華爾街整體對Anthropic的樂觀情緒。
Freedman其實是給予Anthropic「持有」評等的兩名分析師之一。他表示，投資期間只有三至六個月的短線投資人，或許應該等待更便宜的進場價格，原因在於，Anthropic部分投資人持有的股票在IPO後的幾個月內仍受到閉鎖期限制，隨著閉鎖期陸續屆滿，未來幾個月可能出現賣壓。
不過，從長期來看，Freedman認為，Anthropic的服務有15%至20%的機率，能成為類似微軟(MSFT-US)的白領工作者作業系統。在這種情境下，Anthropic銷售的不只是Claude AI模型所提供的「原始智慧」，還包括工作者每天使用的外掛介面及應用程式。
Freedman說：「關鍵在於，誰掌握工作用作業系統，這才是真正重要的事。這就是看好Anthropic的理由，也就是它有機會成為一個平台，長期而言發展成類似微軟的企業。」
Freedman也觀察即時數據，指出儘管Anthropic曾警告，冬季假期期間的使用量可能下滑，但自上次公布數據以來，該公司營收仍持續成長。

Freedman看好成本下降 Wang憂心算力融資與需求不足

Freedman表示，從長期來看，Anthropic將同時受惠於兩項成本下降因素。
首先，隨著運算效率改善，訓練新模型及回應使用者查詢的成本，每年都在下降。其次，在運算需求緊俏程度達到高峰後，運算能力的成本也可望降低。
Freedman認為，即使Anthropic調降AI服務價格，這兩項因素仍將支撐其利潤率。
相較之下，Wang在訪問中表示，他認為Anthropic對算力的迫切需求，可能遭遇投資人對AI基建投資轉趨謹慎的阻力，近期新雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)融資成本大幅攀升，便已凸顯這項問題。Wang指出，如果Anthropic無法取得足夠的算力，變現能力也將被抑制。
與此同時，在OpenAI等競爭對手的激烈競爭下，AI Token價格可能下滑，而要抵銷價格下跌的影響，未來就必須仰賴AI使用量持續增加。
但Wang擔心，市場需求可能根本不足。他預估Anthropic明年營收將達1,200億美元，低於分析師平均預估的1,360億美元。
儘管Wang看好前沿模型可能帶動藥物研發等新突破，但他表示：「很難替這些突破訂出明確的時間表。」相關營收目前也「尚未反映在現有數字中」。
paras_en: Two stock analysts from the same research firm on Wall Street offered starkly different views on the post‑IPO price trajectory of the hot AI stock Anthropic (ANT‑US). One sees long‑term investment appeal, while the other recommends shorting due to data‑center financing and doubts about long‑term commercial demand.

Andrew Freedman, a communications and software analyst at Hedgeye Risk Management, has been publishing research on Anthropic since its initial public offering. On Wednesday (25th), he said the current price level is attractive for long‑term investors.
However, his colleague, Hedgeye global technology analyst Felix Wang, released a report on Tuesday advising clients to short Anthropic shares.

After Wang’s recommendation, Freedman posted on social media to distance himself from the decision, stating he had "not participated in the research or related process that led to that recommendation."

Wang’s bearish view stems from Anthropic’s reliance on data‑center‑based compute, which is increasingly difficult to finance, coupled with market doubts about the long‑term commercial demand for its models.
Freedman, on the other hand, is bullish on Anthropic’s potential to become a next‑generation enterprise operating system and signals strong short‑term demand.
Wang projects the stock will fall to $59, while Freedman sets a fair‑value target of $92. Anthropic closed Wednesday at $82.79 per share.

The internal divergence within the same firm reflects broader market disagreement over AI’s disruptive potential and Anthropic’s valuation role, highlighting the stock’s contentious nature: its valuation once spiked to $2 trillion post‑IPO before falling sharply. The price briefly dipped below $74 on Wednesday, then rebounded near the $83 IPO price.

Rarely do analysts within the same firm take opposing stances; similar cases have occurred, such as Morgan Stanley’s strategists and portfolio managers in 2023 offering divergent views on the overall market outlook.

Typically, Wall Street research teams reach consensus, especially on individual stocks. Hedgeye is an independent research firm; Freedman is the lead analyst tracking Anthropic, which operates across the broad industry sectors Wang studies. Freedman’s view aligns more closely with Wall Street’s overall optimism toward Anthropic.

Freedman is one of two analysts giving Anthropic a "hold" rating. He notes that short‑term investors with 3‑ to 6‑month horizons might wait for a cheaper entry, as some Anthropic shares remain locked for months after the IPO, potentially creating selling pressure as lock‑ups expire.

From a long‑term perspective, Freedman believes Anthropic’s services have a 15% to 20% chance of becoming a workplace operating system similar to Microsoft (MSFT‑US). In that scenario, Anthropic would sell not only the raw intelligence from its Claude AI model but also the plug‑in interfaces and applications used daily by workers.

Freedman said, "The key is who controls the workplace OS; that’s what matters. That’s why I’m bullish on Anthropic—it has the chance to become a platform that, over time, evolves into a Microsoft‑like enterprise."
He also noted real‑time data, pointing out that although Anthropic warned of a dip in usage during the winter holidays, revenue has continued to grow since the last data release.
Freedman is bullish on cost reductions. He says that in the long run, Anthropic will benefit from two cost‑cutting factors.

First, as compute efficiency improves, the cost of training new models and responding to user queries declines annually. Second, after peak demand for compute, the cost of compute capacity is expected to fall.
Freedman believes that even if Anthropic lowers AI service prices, these two factors will sustain its profit margins.

In contrast, Wang expressed concerns that Anthropic’s urgent compute needs may face investor caution toward AI infrastructure, citing the recent steep rise in financing costs for new cloud players like CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) as evidence. Wang warned that without sufficient compute, monetization will be stifled.
Meanwhile, amid fierce competition from rivals such as OpenAI, AI token prices may fall, and to offset the price decline, future growth will require continued increases in AI usage.
Wang worries that market demand may be fundamentally insufficient. He estimates Anthropic’s revenue next year at $120 billion, below the analysts’ average forecast of $136 billion.

Although Wang is optimistic that frontier models could drive breakthroughs in drug discovery and other areas, he says, "It’s hard to set a clear timetable for these breakthroughs." Current revenue figures have "not yet been reflected in the existing numbers."

items.title: 南韓KT Cloud租下凱德60MW資料中心安山自建加租賃拚110MW
items.title_en: South Korea's KT Cloud Rents Keppel 60MW Data Center, Builds Own Facility to Target 110MW
paras: 2026年11月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 南韓雲端業者KT Cloud在安山擴大AI資料中心布局。除了正在興建、規模50MW的安山一號機房，KT Cloud將向新加坡資產管理公司凱德（Keppel）旗下專案公司租用60MW的安山二號機房。兩座機房相距約2.5公里，規劃合計110MW，讓客戶可分階段擴充容量。
根據KT Cloud公告，安山二號的租賃使用權資產約為6,535億韓元，預計於2030年4月30日取得。這是把租期內的租金折算成現值，並非KT Cloud一次付現買下機房。安山二號由凱德方面開發，目標在2030年內啟用，規劃全棟樓層均支援液冷。
安山二號是凱德首度在南韓開發資料中心。凱德先前宣布，旗下第三座資料中心基金將持有專案公司約73%的有效股權；案場已取得建築許可與供電核准。這次的進展是租用方已確定，距機房正式營運仍有數年。
KT集團目標在2031年前新增1GW的AI資料中心容量。安山兩案採不同做法：第一座由KT Cloud自建，第二座由外部投資方開發、KT Cloud承租。兩座合計110MW是規劃容量，並非目前已可交付客戶的算力。

paras_en: On November 26, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – South Korean cloud provider KT Cloud is expanding its AI data‑center footprint in Ansan. In addition to the 50 MW Ansan‑1 hall that is under construction, KT Cloud will lease a 60 MW Ansan‑2 hall from Keppel, the Singapore asset‑management firm’s project company. The two halls are about 2.5 km apart, planned for a total of 110 MW, allowing customers to scale capacity in stages.

According to KT Cloud’s announcement, the lease‑right asset for Ansan‑2 is valued at about 653.5 billion won, expected to be obtained by April 30, 2030. This figure reflects the present value of lease payments over the term and does not represent an outright cash purchase of the hall by KT Cloud. Ansan‑2 is being developed by Keppel, with a target commissioning date within 2030 and a design that supports liquid‑cooling on every floor.

Ansan‑2 marks Keppel’s first data‑center development in South Korea. Keppel previously announced that its third data‑center fund will hold roughly 73 % of the effective equity in the project company; the site has already secured building permits and power‑supply approvals. This progress confirms the lessee, though the hall will not be operational for several more years.

KT Group aims to add 1 GW of AI data‑center capacity by 2031. The two Ansan projects take different approaches: the first hall is built by KT Cloud itself, while the second is developed by an external investor and leased by KT Cloud. The combined 110 MW is the planned capacity, not the amount of compute power currently deliverable to customers.

items.title: 策略師樂觀看待美股後市 標普2027年底上攻1萬點
items.title_en: Strategist Optimistic on US Stock Outlook, S&P 500 Could Reach 10,000 by End‑2027
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，儘管黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US)後，科技股再度重挫，市場也因新一輪關稅疑慮及最新一批偏熱的通膨數據而感到不安，但這些因素並未打消一位策略師對美股做出樂觀、大膽預測的信心。
Federated Hermes全球股票投資長Steve Chiavarone表示，他仍認為標普500指數有機會在2027年底達到1萬點，較目前水準高出40%。這項預測比德意志銀行、滙豐，以及長期看多市場的Yardeni Research創辦人Ed Yardeni近期提出的預測更加樂觀。Yardeni和德銀策略師Binky Chadha對標普500指數的目標價均為9,000點。
Chiavarone坦言，有些人可能認為他的目標過於樂觀，但他強調，這並非盲目樂觀。首先，他目前預估標普500指數2027年和2028年的每股盈餘分別為425美元和490美元，與FactSet統計的市場共識預估423.24美元和495.39美元大致相符。
Chiavarone表示，「我的目標之所以看起來荒謬，唯一原因是過去一個月市場本益比已跌至17倍。」他指出，目前股價反映的是2027年經濟將放緩的預期，但他並不認為這種情況會發生。
他談到，「除非你認為經濟即將陷入衰退，否則本益比不應持續遭到壓縮。」他補充，如果標普500指數明年僅以他預估的2028年每股盈餘為基礎，回升至20倍本益比，指數就有機會達到1萬點。
Chiavarone認為，市場對AI支出即將停滯的擔憂被過度放大。事實上，他表示，2027年資本支出略微放緩，未必是壞事。這可能讓未來幾年的支出更具持續性，也有助於降低市場對所謂「循環融資」疑慮。
這也可能帶動AI晶片成本下降。雖然這對輝達、記憶體大廠美光科技(MU-US)、超微(AMD-US)及其他半導體公司而言，未必是好消息，但Chiavarone表示，這可能讓軟體、網路安全公司及其他優質成長股等AI使用者受惠。
他指出，「晶片股交易最好的時光可能已經過去，但我認為這對AI支出者反而是好事。如果資本支出稍微放緩，價格壓力就會減輕。」
那麼，哪些因素可能讓他的預測落空？Chiavarone表示，科技業獲利成長確實可能比預期更大幅放緩，AI企業也可能出現信用問題，進一步打擊市場信心。但他認為這兩種情境發生的可能性都不高，聯準會(Fed)犯下政策錯誤的風險也不大。
Chiavarone認為，聯準會很可能在12月升息，並可能在2027年初再升息兩次。但他表示，考量到今年第一季伊朗戰爭推升油價，之後通膨年增率的比較基期將逐漸變得有利，屆時通膨數據應會開始改善。
他表示，「聯準會可能停止升息。」他補充，這將有助於市場漲勢擴大。小型股、金融股及其他對利率敏感的股票可能因此受惠。Chiavarone也認為，估值偏低的非必需消費品類股相當具吸引力。他並維持原先看法，認為投資人應開始減碼民生必需品、醫療保健及其他防禦型類股。
沒錯，目前市場看起來確實令人不安。近期股市回檔速度相當快，跌幅也十分顯著。但這可能只是典型的恐慌性賣壓。只要看看VIX恐慌指數就能發現，本月稍早還在15至17左右，，如今已飆升至30左右。
Chiavarone表示，「大家需要先冷靜下來。市場上有很多投資人已經開始動搖。多頭市場通常是在一片自負與狂妄中結束，而不是在不確定與疑慮中落幕。」
這番話或許有道理。華爾街也有一句廣為人知的格言：市場總是在憂慮之牆上攀升。投資人如今正仰望著這道高牆，問題在於，究竟需要什麼條件，才能讓他們重新開始向上攀爬。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that despite Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia (NVDA‑US) triggering another tech‑stock pullback, and market unease over a fresh round of tariff concerns and the latest batch of still‑hot inflation data, those factors have not dampened a strategist’s confidence to make an optimistic, bold forecast for US equities.

Federated Hermes global equities chief Steve Chiavarone said he still believes the S&P 500 has a chance to hit 10,000 points by the end of 2027, about 40% above current levels. This outlook is more upbeat than recent forecasts from Deutsche Bank, HSBC and Yardeni Research founder Ed Yardeni, who both target the index at 9,000 points.

Chiavarone admitted some may view his target as overly optimistic, but he stressed it is not blind optimism. He currently estimates S&P 500 earnings per share of $425 for 2027 and $490 for 2028, roughly in line with FactSet’s consensus forecasts of $423.24 and $495.39 respectively.

He explained, “My target looks absurd only because the market P/E ratio has slipped to 17 over the past month.” He noted that today’s prices reflect expectations of a slowing economy in 2027, a scenario he does not believe will materialise.

He added, “Unless you think the economy is about to fall into recession, the P/E ratio should not keep being compressed.” If the index were to rebound to a 20‑times P/E next year based on his 2028 earnings estimate, it could reach the 10,000‑point level.

Chiavarone argued that worries about AI spending stalling are overstated. In fact, a modest slowdown in 2027 capital expenditures may not be a bad thing, as it could make spending more sustainable in the years ahead and ease concerns about so‑called “circular financing.”

That could also drive AI‑chip costs down. While that may not be welcome news for Nvidia, memory giant Micron Technology (MU‑US), AMD (AMD‑US) and other semiconductor firms, Chiavarone said it could benefit software, cybersecurity firms and other high‑growth stocks that use AI.
He noted, “The best trading days for chip stocks may be behind us, but I think that’s actually good for AI spenders. A slight slowdown in capex eases price pressure.”

What could derail his forecast? Chiavarone said tech profit growth could slow more than expected and AI companies might face credit issues, both of which could dent confidence. He believes the likelihood of either scenario is low and that the Fed is unlikely to make a policy mistake.

Chiavarone expects the Fed to raise rates in December and possibly twice more in early 2027. He added that, given the oil‑price spike from the Iran war in Q1, the base for year‑over‑year inflation will become more favorable, allowing inflation data to improve over time.

He said, “The Fed may stop raising rates,” which would help broaden market gains. Small‑caps, financials and other rate‑sensitive stocks could benefit. He also finds undervalued consumer‑discretionary stocks attractive and maintains his view that investors should start trimming exposure to staples, healthcare and other defensive sectors.

Indeed, the market looks uneasy now. Recent pullbacks have been swift and steep, but that may simply be typical panic selling. A glance at the VIX shows it was around 15‑17 earlier this month and has now surged to roughly 30.
Chiavarone warned, “Everyone needs to calm down first. Many investors are already wavering. Bull markets usually end in a wave of hubris and overconfidence, not in uncertainty and doubt.”

That may be true. Wall Street has a well‑known saying: markets always climb the wall of worry. Investors are now staring at that high wall, and the question is what conditions are needed for them to start climbing upward again.

items.title: 馬來西亞未承諾救亞航財長：若出手，政府須優先於其他債權人
items.title_en: Malaysia Has Not Pledged to Bail Out AirAsia, Finance Minister Says: If Government Steps In, It Must Rank Ahead of Other Creditors
paras: 2026年11月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 馬來西亞政府仍未承諾金援廉航亞航集團AirAsia(5238-MY)，但已說明介入的條件。馬來西亞第二財長阿米爾26日在國會表示，若政府決定提供支援，公帑的受償順位須排在其他債權人之前，政府也會要求加強對董事會及管理層的監督。
這項條件牽動亞航正在籌辦的再融資。公司先前規劃從國際債市籌措最多10億美元，另尋求7億馬幣本地授信，主要用於既有債務再融資，原預期在今年12月至明年2月完成。若政府支援最終涉及調整受償順位，既有及新債權人能否接受新條件，將影響融資如何談成。
亞航第3季合併淨損由前一季8.31億馬幣縮小至3.81億馬幣，但季底現金及銀行存款降至9.05億馬幣，流動負債則升至192億馬幣。公司預期，第4季燃油成本仍將高於第3季。
亞航承載馬來西亞近六成國內航空客運量。阿米爾表示，政府關注的是國內航線能否維持，監測範圍不包括亞航海外業務；目前尚未就貸款、擔保或注資作出承諾。

paras_en: On November 26, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The Malaysian government has still not committed to financially supporting low‑cost carrier AirAsia Group (5238‑MY), but it has outlined the conditions for any intervention. Malaysia’s second finance minister, Amir, told Parliament on the 26th that if the government decides to provide assistance, the repayment priority of public funds must be placed ahead of other creditors, and the government will also demand stronger oversight of the board and management.

This condition affects the refinancing that AirAsia is currently arranging. The company had previously planned to raise up to US$1 billion from the international bond market and to seek an additional RM7 billion of local credit, mainly for refinancing existing debt, with an original expectation to complete the process between December this year and February next year. If government support ultimately requires a change in repayment priority, whether existing and new creditors can accept the new terms will determine how the financing can be concluded.

AirAsia’s consolidated net loss for Q3 narrowed to RM381 million from RM831 million in the prior quarter, but cash and bank deposits at quarter‑end fell to RM905 million, while current liabilities rose to RM19.2 billion. The company expects fuel costs in Q4 to remain higher than in Q3.

AirAsia carries nearly 60% of Malaysia’s domestic passenger traffic. Amir said the government’s concern is whether domestic routes can be maintained, and its monitoring does not extend to AirAsia’s overseas operations; no commitment has yet been made regarding loans, guarantees or capital injections.

items.title_en: SoftBank stock rebounds 7.3%, CDS hits four-year high, $10 billion loan linked to OpenAI valuation
paras: 2026年11月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本軟銀集團(9984-JP)股價26日收漲7.3%，信用市場卻朝反方向走。軟銀五年期信用違約交換（CDS）利差連兩日擴大，26日一度升至534.6個基點，較前一日擴大逾20個基點，創四年新高。這代表投資人為軟銀債務購買違約保障的成本上升，並非公司已違約。
軟銀財報顯示，願景基金二期旗下子公司8月借入100億美元，由軟銀集團提供保證，並以借款子公司的現金擔保帳戶作為擔保。OpenAI特別股本身沒有拿去抵押，但貸款條款參考這批特別股的公允價值。若估值大幅下跌，借款方可能得補現金擔保或提前還款。
這筆貸款與軟銀10月1日完成的另筆100億美元OpenAI股權投資不同。後者以發行優先順位債券籌得的資金支付，使軟銀對OpenAI累計投資達646億美元、持股約13%。
軟銀未公布這筆貸款的確切估值門檻，也未揭露已因估值變動被要求追加擔保或提前還款。

paras_en: On November 26, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Japan’s SoftBank Group (9984-JP) saw its share price rise 7.3% on the 26th, while the credit market moved in the opposite direction. The five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread for SoftBank widened for two consecutive days, reaching 534.6 basis points on the 26th – more than 20 basis points higher than the previous day – a four‑year peak. This indicates that investors are paying a higher cost for default protection on SoftBank’s debt, not that the company has actually defaulted.

SoftBank’s financial statements show that a subsidiary of its Vision Fund II borrowed $10 billion in August, guaranteed by SoftBank Group and secured by the cash‑collateral account of the borrowing subsidiary. The OpenAI preferred shares themselves were not pledged, but the loan terms reference the fair value of those preferred shares. If the valuation drops sharply, the borrower may have to provide additional cash collateral or repay early.

This loan is distinct from the separate $10 billion OpenAI equity investment SoftBank completed on October 1, which was funded by issuing senior‑ranked bonds, bringing SoftBank’s cumulative investment in OpenAI to $64.6 billion and an ownership stake of about 13%.
SoftBank did not disclose the exact valuation trigger for this loan, nor reveal whether any additional collateral or early repayment has already been required due to valuation changes.

items.title_en: China Stocks Close/Shanghai Composite Hits 16-Month Intraday Low Then Levels Off, Semiconductors Down 2%, Telecom Equipment Rises Against Trend
paras: 2026年11月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國股市26日開高走低，上證綜合指數盤中一度下跌約0.6%，創2025年7月以來新低，終場小漲0.01%，收在3,477點。滬深300指數早盤一度漲約0.6%，收盤也回到平盤附近。美國再提關稅方案，加上AI類股賣壓未退，陸股未能延續早盤漲勢。
陸股半導體類股指數下跌2%，科創50指數跌1.36%，新能源車類股指數跌1.3%。電池大廠寧德時代(300750-CN)盤中一度跌2.9%，觸及26個月低點。深證成指收跌0.02%，創業板指小漲0.29%。
通訊設備股走勢相反，類股上漲2.74%。中國工信部等三部門公布新一代通訊網建設方案，要求擴大5G進階版（5G-A）覆蓋、推動萬兆光網試點，並視情況啟動6G網路建設。方案未列出6G開工日期。
美國貿易代表署針對包括中國在內的14個貿易夥伴提出新一輪產能過剩相關關稅，措施仍在徵詢意見，尚未生效。中國交易所則將於11月30日起，把融資買進的最低保證金比率由100%降至80%。

paras_en: November 26, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – China’s stock market opened higher but fell later on the 26th. The Shanghai Composite index slipped about 0.6% intraday, hitting a new low not seen since July 2025, and finished with a modest 0.01% gain at 3,477 points. The CSI 300 index rose roughly 0.6% early in the session but closed back near flat. U.S. tariff proposals and lingering selling pressure on AI stocks prevented mainland shares from sustaining their early gains.

Semiconductor stocks in mainland China fell 2%, the STAR 50 index dropped 1.36%, and the new‑energy vehicle index slipped 1.3%. Battery giant CATL (300750‑CN) fell as much as 2.9% intraday, touching a 26‑month low. The Shenzhen Component index closed down 0.02%, while the ChiNext index edged up 0.29%.

Telecom equipment stocks moved in the opposite direction, rising 2.74%. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and two other ministries released a next‑generation communications network construction plan that calls for expanding coverage of 5G‑Advanced (5G‑A), piloting terabit‑speed optical networks, and, where appropriate, launching 6G network construction. The plan does not specify a start date for 6G.

The U.S. Office of the United States Trade Representative has proposed a new round of anti‑overcapacity tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China. The measures are still under public consultation and have not taken effect. Meanwhile, Chinese exchanges will lower the minimum margin requirement for margin‑buying from 100% to 80% starting November 30.

items.title: Skanska再接2.75億美元資料中心工程喬治亞州48MW機房已開工
items.title_en: Skanska Secures Additional $275 Million Data‑Center Project; 48 MW Facility in Georgia Has Broken Ground
paras: 2026年11月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 瑞典營建商Skanska宣布，從既有客戶取得2.75億美元追加工程合約，為美國喬治亞州一座48MW資料中心興建主體、進行內部裝修，並另建一棟水處理設施。工程已於11月開工，預計2028年10月完工。這筆合約將列入Skanska今年第4季美國新接訂單。
Skanska今年9月曾在喬治亞州取得8,400萬美元的資料中心工程合約，當時公布的容量同為48MW，樓地板面積也同為約2.27萬平方公尺，原訂11月開工、2028年第3季完工。兩次公告的規模與開工月份相符，可能指向同一案場，但公司未確認兩筆合約的關係，也未公布客戶名稱。
Skanska這次公布的是施工完成目標，並未說明何時送電或開始營運。對資料中心設備商而言，這筆合約可用來追蹤工程進度，但還無法據此判斷伺服器何時進場。

paras_en: On November 26, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Swedish construction firm Skanska announced it has received a $275 million follow‑on contract from an existing client to build the main structure and carry out interior fit‑out for a 48 MW data‑center in Georgia, USA, as well as to construct a water‑treatment facility. Construction began in November and completion is slated for October 2028. The contract will be counted as a new order for Skanska in the United States in Q4 of this year.

In September, Skanska secured an $84 million data‑center contract in Georgia, at the time announcing the same 48 MW capacity and roughly 22,700 square‑metre floor area, with an original start date in November and completion targeted for Q3 2028. The scale and start month of the two announcements match, suggesting they may refer to the same site, though the company has not confirmed the relationship between the two contracts nor disclosed the client’s name.

This announcement from Skanska specifies only the construction completion target and does not indicate when power will be supplied or operations will commence. For data‑center equipment vendors, the contract provides a reference point for tracking construction progress, but it does not allow any inference about when servers will be installed.

items.title: 滙豐看好2027年：AI震盪反而創造進場甜蜜點
items.title_en: HSBC bullish on 2027: AI turbulence instead creates a sweet entry point
paras: 對投資人而言，現在似乎不是特別有利的時刻：通膨持續頑強攀升，聯準會(Fed)似乎幾乎確定將再次升息。與此同時，人工智慧(AI)交易正讓市場劇烈震盪，如今關稅議題也再度浮上檯面。但滙豐控股(HSBC)策略師卻認為，股市實際上可能正處於一個難得的甜蜜點。
滙豐新興市場及全球股票策略主管Alastair Pinder表示，近期由AI造成的全球股市波動，實際上已改善2027年的風險報酬比。
他認為，股市雖然已從高點大幅回落，但實際情況只是股票變得更便宜，而非陷入持續下跌的漩渦。
Pinder寫道：「若要讓這波跌勢演變成更持久的空頭市場，導致估值下修的壓力就必須大幅升高，包括市場對AI變現能力的疑慮、債券殖利率上升及聯準會(Fed)立場更加鷹派，以及能源價格再度帶來壓力。我們預期情況將朝相反方向發展。」

超大型雲端業者現金流可望觸底 企業導入AI有望提升生產力

儘管許多投資人擔心大型科技公司為建置AI基礎設施而大規模舉債，Pinder預料，美國超大型雲端服務業者的自由現金流將在2027年上半年觸底，之後隨著雲端營收預估加速成長、資本支出放緩而回升。
此外，隨著更多企業採用AI，應該會開始看到生產力提升的實際證據。
雖然市場幾乎篤定Fed下個月將升息，但目前市場已反映Fed至2027年年中累計升息65個基點的預期，「導致鷹派意外出現的門檻很高」。此外，能源價格的基期效應自明年3月起將轉趨有利，可能減輕通膨壓力。
他也指出，從歷史經驗來看，在Fed升息幅度較溫和的緊縮周期中，標普500指數在前12個月平均上漲16%。
與此同時，股票估值「開始反映最糟情境……全球科技股估值目前隱含的中期EPS成長率接近零，遠低於2025年年中約25%的水準」。
美國及國際股市近期的跌勢，似乎與2027年企業獲利仍可能保持穩健的情況不相符。目前市場共識預估，標普500指數成分股明年每股盈餘將年增17%。
換句話說，在美國企業獲利展現韌性、股票估值相對溫和的情況下，隨著AI投資放緩、生產力提升效益逐漸顯現，股市在2027年可能再度走揚。
不過，凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)資深市場經濟學家James Reilly提醒，市場共識預估往往落後於實際情況，歷史經驗也顯示，企業獲利預估很可能下修。他寫道：「即使只是對分析師的獲利預期進行溫和下修，美股看起來仍相對昂貴。」
儘管如此，Pinder對經濟成長前景仍較為樂觀。考量美國企業獲利成長前景強勁，他對美股維持加碼，至於新興市場在近期遭遇賣壓之後，估值已降至過低水準，因此也予以加碼。他對歐股維持中立，對日股則採取減碼立場。
Pinder說：「我們偏好資產負債表穩健的企業，尤其是半導體製造商及超大型雲端服務業者。隨著經濟成長維持韌性，我們也看好景氣循環股，除了科技股之外，金融、工業及原物料類股也都維持加碼。」
paras_en: For investors, now does not seem like a particularly favorable moment: inflation remains stubbornly high, the Fed appears almost certain to raise rates again, AI trading is causing market volatility, and tariff issues have resurfaced. Yet HSBC strategists believe the equity market may actually be at a rare sweet spot.

Alastair Pinder, head of emerging markets and global equity strategy at HSBC, said that the recent AI‑driven volatility in global equity markets has actually improved the risk‑return profile for 2027.
He believes that although the market has pulled back sharply from its highs, the reality is simply that stocks have become cheaper, not that they are caught in a persistent down‑trend.

Pinder wrote: “For this pull‑back to turn into a longer‑lasting bear market, the pressure to cut valuations would have to rise sharply, including doubts about AI’s monetisation, rising bond yields, a more hawkish Fed stance, and renewed energy‑price pressures. We expect the opposite to happen.”

Despite many investors worrying that large tech firms are taking on massive debt to build AI infrastructure, Pinder expects the free cash flow of U.S. hyperscale cloud providers to bottom in the first half of 2027 and then recover as cloud revenue forecasts accelerate and capital spending slows.
Moreover, as more companies adopt AI, we should start seeing tangible evidence of productivity gains.

While the market is almost certain the Fed will raise rates next month, it has already priced in expectations of a cumulative 65‑basis‑point hike by mid‑2027, making the threshold for an unexpected hawkish shift very high. In addition, the base‑effect of energy prices is set to turn favourable from March next year, potentially easing inflation pressures.
He also noted that historically, during periods of relatively moderate Fed tightening, the S&P 500 has risen an average of 16% over the first 12 months.

At the same time, stock valuations are “starting to reflect the worst‑case scenario… the implied mid‑term EPS growth rate for global tech stocks is now near zero, far below the roughly 25% level seen around mid‑2025.”

The recent declines in U.S. and international equity markets seem at odds with the view that corporate earnings could remain robust in 2027. The consensus now expects S&P 500 component companies to post a 17% year‑over‑year earnings per share increase next year.

In other words, with resilient U.S. corporate earnings and relatively moderate valuations, combined with a slowdown in AI spending and gradually materialising productivity benefits, the market could rally again in 2027.

However, James Reilly, senior market economist at Capital Economics, warned that consensus forecasts often lag reality and historically earnings forecasts are likely to be revised down. He wrote: “Even a modest downgrade of analysts’ earnings expectations would make U.S. equities still look relatively expensive.”

Nevertheless, Pinder remains more optimistic about growth prospects. Given the strong earnings outlook for U.S. companies, he maintains a net‑add stance on U.S. equities, and after recent selling pressure has pushed emerging‑market valuations to overly low levels, he is also adding there. He stays neutral on European stocks and is reducing exposure to Japanese equities.

Pinder said: “We prefer companies with strong balance sheets, especially semiconductor manufacturers and hyperscale cloud providers. With economic growth remaining resilient, we are also bullish on cyclical stocks – beyond tech, we are adding to financials, industrials and materials.”

items.title: 「AI股神」Q3虧65%！槓桿押注AI股一度瀕臨崩潰 前三季仍賺88.5%
items.title_en: “AI Stock God” Q3 Losses 65% as Leveraged AI Bets Nearly Crashed, Yet Still Up 88.5% in First Three Quarters
paras: 外媒披露，曾被市場奉為「AI股神」、25歲前OpenAI研究員Leopold Aschenbrenner旗下Situational Awareness基金，第3季淨值暴跌65%，主因是高度槓桿押注7月曾讓該基金幾乎崩潰的人工智慧(AI)股。但今年來至9月底的收益仍達88.5%，顯示上半年累積可觀獲利。
Situational Awareness在華爾街日報(WSJ)取得的投資人信函中揭露報酬。值得注意的是，信中提及的第3季績效，並未反映10月AI的劇烈震盪：當時AI企業估值受到市場檢視，與AI基建熱潮相關的股票也劇烈震盪。
Aschenbrenner在信中寫道，Anthropic(ANT-US)11月19日上市後，Situational Awareness的投資組合約有70%配置於上市股票，另外30%則投資於未上市企業。Anthropic占了該基金未上市企業投資部位中最大的比重。
報導指出，該基金仍可能調整投資組合、降低對Anthropic的配置比重，但Aschenbrenner表示，以首次公開發行(IPO)價格而言，基金仍「高度看好」Anthropic。
Aschenbrenner在信中表示，近期市場動盪讓他學到教訓，因此正採取更審慎的風險管理方式。根據報導，他向投資人說：「波動可以接受；但即使我們完全看錯，也絕不能承擔足以威脅基金生存的風險。」

7月AI市場恐慌 曾導致保證金追繳

今年7月，由於市場短暫出現對AI產業的恐慌情緒，並迅速蔓延至全球市場，銀行因此對Situational Awareness發出追繳保證金通知，使該基金一度瀕臨崩潰，成為AI交易劇烈波動的代表案例。
最終，該公司將公開股票投資組合中的一大部分出售給Ken Griffin旗下的城堡證券(Citadel)。
Aschenbrenner以自己2024年撰寫、在網路上廣泛流傳的一篇文章為旗下基金命名，並將投資重心放在他認為將受惠於AI革命的企業，很快就以運用槓桿放大報酬及風險的投資方式聞名。
paras_en: Foreign media disclosed that the Situational Awareness fund, once hailed by the market as the “AI Stock God” and run by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner before he turned 25, saw its net asset value plunge 65% in Q3, mainly because of a highly leveraged bet on AI stocks that almost caused the fund to collapse in July. Nevertheless, its returns through the end of September this year still reached 88.5%, showing a sizable profit accumulated in the first half of the year.

The fund’s performance was revealed in an investor letter obtained by the Wall Street Journal (WSJ). Notably, the Q3 results mentioned in the letter do not reflect the severe turbulence in AI that began in October, when AI company valuations came under market scrutiny and stocks tied to the AI‑infrastructure boom swung wildly.

Aschenbrenner wrote in the letter that after Anthropic (ANT‑US) went public on November 19, roughly 70% of Situational Awareness’s portfolio was allocated to listed equities, with the remaining 30% invested in private companies. Anthropic made up the largest share of the fund’s private‑company holdings.

The report noted that the fund may still rebalance its portfolio and reduce its exposure to Anthropic, but Aschenbrenner said that, based on the IPO price, the fund remains “very bullish” on Anthropic.

Aschenbrenner said in the letter that recent market volatility taught him a lesson, prompting a more cautious risk‑management approach. He told investors, “Volatility is acceptable; but even if we are completely wrong, we must never take risks that could threaten the fund’s survival.”

July AI‑market panic triggered a margin call. In July this year, a brief wave of panic over the AI sector spread globally, prompting banks to issue a margin‑call notice to Situational Awareness, pushing the fund to the brink of collapse and making it a textbook example of the extreme swings in AI trading.
Eventually, the firm sold a large portion of its public‑stock holdings to Ken Griffin’s Citadel Securities.

Aschenbrenner named the fund after an article he wrote in 2024 that went viral online, and he focused the fund’s investments on companies he believes will benefit from the AI revolution, quickly gaining a reputation for using leverage to amplify both returns and risk.

items.title: 川普啟動產能過剩關稅：日本抗議、巴西反嗆「不合法、將對等回擊」
items.title_en: Trump Launches Overcapacity Tariffs: Japan Protests, Brazil Retorts "Illegal, Will Retaliate in Kind"
paras: 美國貿易代表辦公室(USTR)周三(25日)宣布，擬對日本進口商品課徵15%關稅，並保留上調至20%空間；同時對巴西成品飛機加徵10%從價稅、對配額外原糖設新稅率，措施依據「產能過剩調查」與301條款，聲稱要倒逼貿易對手糾正非市場做法。
日本內閣官房長官木原稔周四(26日)明確否認「結構性產能過剩」指控，並稱「日本沒有任何非市場政策或做法，美方舉措令人遺憾。」
日本15%稅率落在去年與美國協議框架之內，東京承諾5500億美元對美投資計畫，換取美方將多數商品關稅天花板設在15%、汽車適用更低稅率；協議並載明若東京當局投資不到位，華府可加稅。雖然美國最高法院今年2月裁定川普全球關稅無效後，多數日貨稅率曾降至12.5%，但日方仍咬牙履約。
目前，日本已分三輪公布投資案、總額1300億美元，推進速度快於南韓等同類協議方，日本經濟產業大臣赤澤亮正此前承諾「忠實落實就不會破15%」，木原稔也強調投資穩步執行。抗議歸抗議，東京選擇用資本換關稅緩衝。
巴西反應則更強硬。巴西外交部譴責USTR「單方面決定不可接受」，指出8月21日巴西總統魯拉跟川普通话後雙方同意設工作組，但美方遲未提交協定框架，談判自9月停滯；新關稅實為施壓巴西修改Pix支付、數位貿易與優惠協定等國內監管。
USTR代表格里爾表示，巴西「一年談判無實質進展」，巴西反斥美方藉飛機、糖兩大支柱產業開刀，並強調「不向威脅低頭」，同時尋求多元市場分散風險。
同樣被加稅，日本用「投資換穩定」，巴西用「規則戰＋對等威脅」。華爾街更在意前者：汽車與半導體供應鏈關稅不失控，是亞洲風險資產的底，後者則把農產、民航與數位主權扯進2027選舉週期。川普的關稅工具箱從「緊急狀態」轉回301條款，法律更穩、談判更狠，全球貿易折現率再度上修。
paras_en: The U.S. Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) announced on Wednesday (the 25th) that it plans to impose a 15% tariff on Japanese imports, with the possibility of raising it to 20%; at the same time it will add a 10% ad‑valorem duty on finished aircraft from Brazil and set a new rate for extra‑quota raw sugar. The measures are based on an “overcapacity investigation” and Section 301, and are said to be intended to force trading partners to correct non‑market practices.

Japan’s Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara on Thursday (the 26th) flatly denied the allegation of “structural overcapacity,” stating that “Japan has no non‑market policies or practices, and the U.S. action is regrettable.”

The 15% Japanese rate falls within the framework of last year’s agreement with the United States, under which Tokyo pledged a $550 billion investment plan in the U.S. in exchange for the U.S. capping most tariffs at 15% and applying a lower rate to automobiles. The agreement also stipulates that if Tokyo fails to meet its investment commitments, Washington can raise the duties. Although the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in February that Trump’s global tariffs were invalid, most Japanese‑made goods saw rates fall to 12.5%, Japan has nonetheless pressed ahead with its commitments.

To date Japan has announced three rounds of investment projects totaling $130 billion, moving faster than South Korea and other counterparties. Japan’s Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Ryosuke Akazawa previously pledged to “faithfully implement it so the 15% ceiling will not be broken,” and Kihara emphasized that the investments are being carried out steadily. In short, Tokyo is using capital to offset the tariff pressure.

Brazil’s response is far tougher. Brazil’s foreign ministry condemned the USTR’s “unilateral decision as unacceptable,” noting that on August 21 President Lula and Trump agreed to set up a working group, but the U.S. has yet to submit a framework, and negotiations have stalled since September. The new tariffs are seen as pressure on Brazil to change its Pix payment system, digital trade rules and preferential‑trade agreements.

USTR representative Gillian (Grill) said Brazil has seen “a year of negotiations with no substantive progress,” accusing Brazil of using its two flagship sectors—aircraft and sugar—to fight back, and stressing that “we will not bow to threats,” while Brazil is seeking to diversify markets to spread risk.

Both Japan and Brazil are hit by the new duties, but Japan is responding with “investment for stability,” whereas Brazil is using “rules‑based warfare and reciprocal threats.” Wall Street is more focused on the former: keeping auto and semiconductor supply‑chain tariffs in check is seen as the floor for Asian risk assets, while the latter drags agriculture, civil aviation and digital sovereignty into the 2027 election cycle. Trump’s tariff toolbox has shifted from an “emergency” basis back to Section 301, a more legally solid and tougher negotiating lever, pushing up the global trade discount rate again.

items.title: 日銀委員釋加快升息訊號 稱須迅速因應通膨風險
items.title_en: BoJ Official Signals Faster Rate Hikes, Says Prompt Action Needed on Inflation Risks
paras: 《路透社》報導，日本銀行(BoJ)審議委員田村直樹(Naoki Tamura)週四(26日)表示，央行必須迅速因應通膨超出預期的跡象，包括加快升息步調。
田村在一場演講中表示，「考量到金融情勢仍維持寬鬆，我認為日本銀行應盡快將政策利率調升至被認為對經濟中性的水準。」
田村指出，原物料成本上升，包括中東衝突推升原油價格，已導致批發通膨大幅攀升，價格壓力也逐漸擴散至各類消費產品。
他表示，受到中東局勢發展不確定性、日元走勢，以及AI相關商品需求依然強勁等因素影響，「近期物價變化顯示，通膨面臨進一步上行風險」。
田村指出，日本的通膨預期不像其他經濟體那樣穩固錨定，因此更有必要進一步升息。
他表示，金融情勢仍維持寬鬆，調查顯示，日本銀行過去的升息措施，以及未來可能進行的升息，不太可能對企業活動造成重大衝擊。
田村表示，「每次升息後的幾個月內，日銀便能根據企業訪談取得的資訊，以及各項調查結果，合理評估金融情勢。」
他指出，「日本的潛在消費者物價指數(CPI)通膨，尚未像其他經濟體一樣穩固錨定在央行2%的目標，因此我認為，央行必須迅速因應物價出現上行偏離目標的跡象，包括加快政策利率的升息步調。」
paras_en: Reuters reported that BoJ policy‑maker Naoki Tamura said on Thursday (the 26th) that the central bank must act quickly to inflation that is running hotter than expected, including accelerating the pace of rate hikes.

Tamura said in a speech that, given financial conditions remain accommodative, he believes the Bank of Japan should raise the policy rate to a level considered neutral for the economy as soon as possible.

He noted that rising commodity costs, including higher oil prices driven by Middle‑East conflict, have caused wholesale inflation to surge sharply, with price pressures spreading to a wide range of consumer goods.

Tamura added that recent price developments, amid uncertainty over the Middle‑East situation, the yen’s trajectory and still‑strong demand for AI‑related products, show inflation faces further upside risk.
He pointed out that Japan’s inflation expectations are not as firmly anchored as in other economies, making additional rate hikes even more necessary.
Tamura said that because financial conditions remain loose, surveys indicate that past BoJ rate hikes and any future hikes are unlikely to cause a major shock to corporate activity.
He explained that “in the months following each rate hike, the BoJ can reasonably assess financial conditions based on information gathered from corporate interviews and various surveys.”

He concluded that “Japan’s underlying CPI inflation has not yet become as firmly anchored at the 2% target as in other economies, so the central bank must respond swiftly to signs of price deviations upward, including speeding up the pace of policy‑rate hikes.”

items.title: 美啟動「產能過剩」301關稅：南韓暫守15%、中國20%　1月聽證定生死
items.title_en: U.S. Launches “Overcapacity” 301 Tariffs: South Korea Holds at 15%, China at 20% – Jan Hearing Will Decide Fate
paras: 美國貿易代表辦公室(USTR)週三(25日)公布《貿易法》第301條調查結果，指稱南韓、日本、中國、歐盟等14個經濟體透過產業補貼、政策金融與非市場經濟進口，製造「結構性產能過剩」，擬對相關商品加徵關稅，此舉顯示華府意在最高法院此前裁定對等關稅無效後，換一套法律外衣重建關稅壁壘，重新掌握單邊貿易制裁的主動權。
根據USTR提出的建議方案，擬對南韓、日本及歐盟商品課徵最高15%的關稅，對中國大陸擬課20%，但對川普第一任期內已被加徵約25%關稅的部分商品，此次20%將作為額外稅率疊加，且備案中最高稅率可達40%。不過，這並非最終實施稅率，USTR將在明年1月5日前接收書面意見，並於1月25日舉行公開聽證會，隨後才會敲定最終措施。
綜合《KBS》、《韓聯社》等韓媒報導，南韓此次暫時守住15%的關稅天花板，關鍵在於去年兩國達成的3500億美元對美投資協議及能源採購承諾。去年雙方商定將關稅上限設定在15%，此前市場普遍擔憂，南韓今年對美貿易順差大幅擴大，恐引發美方突破上限。
受AI投資熱潮推動，今年前10月南韓對美貿易順差1023億美元，史上首次突破千億美元大關，超過去年495億美元的兩倍，這一數據雖然支撐出口，但也讓華府更有籌碼施壓首爾對阿拉斯加液化天然氣(LNG)等對美投資項目的落實進度。
然而，USTR點名南韓汽車、半導體、石油化工等產業受國策銀行過度扶持，若後續磋商進展或投資履約情況未能令美方滿意，稅率可再拉升至25%。日本和歐盟的備案最高稅率則為20%，這意味著「15%」並非永久保險，而是一個動態的談判基線。
更敏感的火藥庫在「數位政策」領域。美方已將韓數位監管措施視為非關稅貿易壁壘，美國國會近期也釋出信號暗示，恐對數位貿易領域啟動新的301調查。這讓不確定性從傳統關稅表延伸到平台經濟、AI治理與跨境資料流規則，為韓美經貿關係埋下另一顆未爆彈。
市場分析師解讀這套「產能過剩關稅」有兩條主線：短期來看，主要盟友稅率「可控」避免了供應鏈即時斷鏈，但半導體、電池、汽車等關鍵出口成本仍將墊高，企業利潤率面臨壓縮；中長期而言，這套基於301條款的關稅比之前的IEEPA緊急狀態稅更耐法律訴訟，恐成為跨政府持續使用的貿易工具。
南韓貿易協會國際貿易通商研究院長張相植(音譯)表示，關稅不確定性有所降低，將有助於企業制定對美投資和出口計畫，但競爭環境隨時可能因談判結果而改變。
華爾街與首爾智庫的共識是：這不是單純的貿易罰單，而是「投資換關稅」的動態綁架機制。短期反彈看AI需求與供應鏈韌性，但企業底線須看華府的政治滿意度。
在1月聽證會結果出爐前，亞洲出口商仍需嚴陣以待，重新檢視原產地佈局與稅號清單，不能再將15%視為不可動搖的永久底線。
paras_en: The U.S. Trade Representative’s Office (USTR) announced on Wednesday (the 25th) the results of its Section 301 investigation under the Trade Act, accusing 14 economies—including South Korea, Japan, China and the EU—of creating “structural overcapacity” through industrial subsidies, policy financing and non‑market‑economy imports, and proposing tariffs on the affected goods. This move shows Washington’s intent to rebuild tariff barriers under a new legal guise after the Supreme Court ruled previous reciprocal tariffs ineffective, thereby regaining the initiative in unilateral trade sanctions.

According to the USTR’s proposed plan, tariffs of up to 15% would be levied on goods from South Korea, Japan and the EU, and 20% on goods from mainland China. For products that were already subject to roughly 25% tariffs during the first Trump administration, the new 20% would be added on top, with a maximum rate in the filing that could reach 40%. These are not final rates; the USTR will accept written comments by Jan. 5 2025 and hold a public hearing on Jan. 25, after which the final measures will be set.

South Korean media such as KBS and Yonhap reported that South Korea’s temporary hold on the 15% tariff ceiling hinges on a $350 billion investment and energy‑procurement pact signed with the United States last year. The two sides agreed to cap tariffs at 15%, easing market fears that South Korea’s sharply expanding trade surplus with the U.S. this year might trigger a breach of that limit.

Driven by the AI investment boom, South Korea’s trade surplus with the U.S. reached $102.3 billion in the first ten months of this year – the first time it has topped $100 billion, more than double the $49.5 billion surplus recorded last year. While this bolsters exports, it also gives Washington more leverage to press Seoul on the implementation of U.S.‑bound projects such as Alaskan LNG.

However, the USTR singled out South Korea’s auto, semiconductor and petrochemical sectors for excessive support from state‑owned banks. If subsequent negotiations or investment compliance fall short of U.S. expectations, the tariff rate could be raised to 25%. The filing lists a maximum of 20% for Japan and the EU, indicating that the “15%” figure is not a permanent guarantee but a dynamic negotiation baseline.

A more sensitive flashpoint lies in the “digital policy” arena. The U.S. has deemed South Korean digital regulation measures a non‑tariff trade barrier, and Congress has recently signaled the possibility of launching a new Section 301 probe in the digital trade space. This extends uncertainty from traditional tariffs to platform economics, AI governance and cross‑border data flow rules, planting another unexploded bomb in the Korea‑U.S. economic relationship.

Market analysts see two strands in this “overcapacity tariff” scheme: in the short term, keeping allied rates “controllable” avoids an immediate supply‑chain break, but key export costs in semiconductors, batteries and automobiles will still rise, squeezing corporate profit margins; in the medium‑to‑long term, a Section 301‑based tariff is more legally resilient than the emergency IEEPA taxes previously used, potentially becoming a lasting tool for inter‑governmental trade pressure.

Zhang Xiangzhi (phonetic), director of the International Trade and Commerce Research Institute at the Korea International Trade Association, said that reduced tariff uncertainty will help firms plan U.S. investments and export strategies, though the competitive environment could shift at any moment depending on negotiation outcomes.

The consensus among Wall Street analysts and Seoul think‑tanks is that this is not a simple trade fine but a dynamic “investment‑for‑tariff” hostage mechanism. Short‑term rebounds may come from AI demand and supply‑chain resilience, but corporate bottom lines will ultimately depend on Washington’s political satisfaction.

Until the January hearing’s outcome is known, Asian exporters must stay on high alert, reassess origin‑allocation strategies and tariff‑code listings, and can no longer treat the 15% rate as an immutable, permanent floor.

items.title: AI記憶體紅利推高經濟成長！南韓央行宣布升息1碼抗通膨 與美利差降至0.75個百分點
items.title_en: AI Memory Bonus Fuels Economic Growth! South Korea Central Bank Raises Interest Rate by 1 Basis Point to Combat Inflation, US-Korea Spread Drops to 0.75 Percentage Point
paras: 南韓央行(BOK)週四(26日)宣布將7天期回購利率上調25個基點至3.25%，結束10月暫停節奏、恢復升息。今年7、8月連升兩次後累計緊縮幅度達75個基點，這是BOK今年下半年第三次升息，與美國的利率差距縮至0.75個百分點。
BOK同步上修經濟成長預期，今年GDP成長率估值從3.3%調高至3.9%，2027年從2.9%上調至4.1%；10月消費者物價指數(CPI)仍達2.8%，核心通膨2.8%，均高於2%目標，房價也還在漲。
驅動力來自「出口端超強、消費端偏弱」的撕裂基本面。全球AI基礎建設投資帶動HBM與企業級NAND超級週期，南韓半導體出口放量，推升經濟成長遠超預期。
BOK決策官員釋放清晰信號：在半導體榮景抵銷家庭需求疲軟、韓股綜合股指(KOSPI)波動的當下，通膨壓力與出口驅動擴張優先級壓過內需擔憂。
不過，市場並非全無顧慮。美銀指出，經常帳順差撐住韓元，但外資持續拋售韓股、綜合指數難守5000點上方；高盛則警告超額利潤集中在三星、海力士兩家，未有效外溢到居民部門，消費僅溫和復甦。
BOK總裁申鉉松隨後記者會成焦點，市場將觀察「終端利率是否衝3.5%」與2027年經濟成長預期會否再上修。若明年GDP成長率估值破3.5%，代表央行對半導體週期更樂觀、緊縮尾巴更長；若措辭轉鴿，則暗示內需與科技股財富效應萎縮已進入決策權衡。
paras_en: The Bank of Korea (BOK) announced on Thursday (26th) that it would raise the 7‑day repo rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, ending the pause in October and resuming rate hikes. After two consecutive increases in July and August, the cumulative tightening has reached 75 basis points, marking the third rate hike for BOK in the second half of the year, and narrowing the gap with U.S. rates to 0.75 percentage point.

BOK also lifted its economic growth outlook, raising the estimated GDP growth rate for this year from 3.3% to 3.9% and for 2027 from 2.9% to 4.1%. The October consumer price index (CPI) remains at 2.8%, core inflation at 2.8%, both above the 2% target, and housing prices continue to rise.

The driving force comes from a split fundamental: a strong export side versus a weaker consumption side. Global AI infrastructure investment is driving a super‑cycle for HBM and enterprise‑grade NAND, boosting South Korean semiconductor exports and pushing economic growth far beyond expectations.

BOK decision makers sent a clear signal: amid the semiconductor boom offsetting weak household demand and volatility in the KOSPI, inflationary pressure and export‑driven expansion take priority over concerns about domestic demand.

However, the market is not without concerns. Bank of America noted that the current account surplus supports the won, but foreign investors continue to sell Korean stocks, making it difficult for the KOSPI to stay above 5,000 points. Goldman Sachs warned that excess profits are concentrated in Samsung and SK Hynix, not effectively spilling over to the consumer sector, and consumption is only mildly recovering.

BOK Governor Seon Hyeon‑song became the focus of a subsequent press conference, with the market watching whether the “terminal rate will hit 3.5%” and whether the 2027 growth outlook will be revised upward. If next year’s GDP growth estimate exceeds 3.5%, it would indicate the central bank is more optimistic about the semiconductor cycle and will keep tightening longer; a dovish tone would suggest that the contraction of domestic demand and the wealth effect of tech stocks have entered decision‑making considerations.

items.title: AI信仰遭遇極限壓力測試！美股超級「V轉」 分析師：深V不是轉折  是分歧
items.title_en: AI Faith Faces Extreme Pressure Test! US Stocks Super “V-Shape” Analysts: Deep V Is Not a Turning Point but a Divergence
paras: 華爾街週三(25日)上演一場「驚魂深V」劇本，盤中恐慌式殺盤，尾盤硬拉收回，但市場情緒的底層邏輯已經換了。
那斯達克100指數(NDX) 開盤5分鐘便重挫近5%，那斯達克指數一度跌約4.5%，標普500盤中跌超3%、道瓊指數(DJI) 一度狂瀉逾1100點，費城半導體(SOX)跌近8%，輝達(NVDA-US) 盤中一度跌近9%，隨後跌幅全數收斂，道瓊翻紅收漲0.33%，標普僅跌0.25%，那指收跌0.62%。
金銀同步演「超級V」，現貨金價盤中最低見到每盎司3426美元，尾盤拉回漲0.92%收3588.41美元，白銀盤中跌超6%，收漲1.15%至41.38美元。
兩天前白宮推動黃仁勳復任輝達執行長，曾讓AI鏈單日暴漲、那指漲超6%，但這波「情緒紓困」沒撐過一日遊。
Running Oak Capital執行長Seth Cogswell直言：「這試圖成為一次AI行業紓困，但沒奏效，人們看穿了。」
更麻煩的是治理溢價被撕開。標普全球評級週三將輝達AA評級列入「負面觀察」，指黃仁勳離任又復職暴露董事會獨立性、接班計畫與監督機制漏洞，90天內可能降至AA-，輝達週三收跌3.91%，CDS違約保護成本創新高。
真正壓抑風險偏好的，是敘事切換。Solstein Capital執行長Terman說：「市場不再爭論AI會不會改變世界，而在問誰能賺錢、能賺多少、數兆美元資本開支能不能回收。諷刺的是，技術承諾兌現了，財務回報卻可能讓投資人失望。」
聯準會(Fed)重啟緊縮讓這道題更尖銳：融資成本抬升，資料中心、HBM、算力租賃的ROI必須更高才合理。期中選舉後民主黨對資料中心擴張的阻力、出口管制不確定性，再疊一層政策折現風險。
NYSE交易廳老將Jonathan Corpina把當前市場情緒跟2008年時類比說道：「不是拋售規模一樣，是那種『接下來還會怎樣』的持續不安。」
TradeMas交易員Peter Tuchman則說：「從未見過同一個故事——英偉達——讓市場看法反轉得這麼徹底。」
分析師指出，拋售「有序」，獲利與宏觀底子還在，但盤面已變成情緒博弈。
Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek苦笑說：「過去10天搖頭次數太多，脖子都酸了。」他客戶最怕的不是繼續跌，而是「萬一反彈踏空」。
深V不是轉折，是分歧。AI技術前景不再是最大爭議，「數兆美元投入能否變成足夠獲利、市場還願不願續費」才是定價核心。短期看Fed態度與輝達治理修補，中期看雲廠資本開支回報，這一輪洗盤後，留下的只會是最有信念、也最會算帳的資金。
paras_en: Wall Street staged a “deep V” drama on Wednesday (25th), with panic selling in the middle of the day and a hard pullback at the close, but the underlying market logic had already shifted.

The Nasdaq 100 (NDX) fell nearly 5% in the first five minutes of trading, the Nasdaq index briefly dropped about 4.5%, the S&P 500 fell over 3% mid‑day, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJI) plunged more than 1,100 points, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) fell nearly 8%, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped almost 9% mid‑day before the declines converged; the Dow ended up 0.33% higher, the S&P only down 0.25%, and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.

Gold and silver both performed a “super V,” with spot gold hitting a low of $3,426 per ounce mid‑day and rebounding 0.92% to close at $3,588.41, while silver fell over 6% mid‑day and closed up 1.15% at $41.38.

Two days ago the White House pushed for Jensen Huang’s reappointment as Nvidia CEO, which once caused a one‑day surge in AI stocks and a 6% rise in the Nasdaq, but this “emotional relief” did not last beyond the day.
Running Oak Capital CEO Seth Cogswell bluntly said, “This was an attempt to provide a bailout for the AI industry, but it failed; people see through it.”

Complicating matters further, governance premiums were ripped apart. S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia’s AA rating under “negative watch” on Wednesday, citing that Huang’s departure and return exposed board independence, succession planning, and oversight mechanism weaknesses, with a possible downgrade to AA‑ within 90 days. Nvidia fell 3.91% on Wednesday and CDS default protection costs hit a new high.

The real risk‑aversion comes from a narrative shift. Solstein Capital CEO Terman said, “The market no longer debates whether AI will change the world; it asks who can make money, how much, and whether the trillions of dollars in capital spend can be recouped. Ironically, the technology promise has been fulfilled, but financial returns may disappoint investors.”

The Fed’s re‑tightening makes this issue sharper: financing costs rise, and the ROI for data centers, HBM, and compute‑as‑a‑service must be higher to be justified. After the midterm election, Democratic resistance to data‑center expansion, export‑control uncertainty, and additional policy discount risk stack on.
NYSE veteran Jonathan Corpina compared the current market sentiment to 2008, saying, “It’s not the same scale of selling, but the persistent unease about ‘what will happen next’.”
TradeMas trader Peter Tuchman said, “I’ve never seen the same story—Nvidia—flip market sentiment so thoroughly.”
Analysts noted that the sell‑off is “ordered,” profits and macro fundamentals remain, but the market has become an emotional game.

Siebert Financial CIO Mark Malek grimaced, “We’ve been shaking our heads too many times in the past 10 days; our necks are sore.” He said his clients fear not a continued decline but a missed rebound if they sell too early.

The deep V is not a turning point but a divergence. The future of AI technology is no longer the biggest debate; the question is whether trillions of dollars of investment can generate sufficient profit and whether the market will continue to pay for it. In the short term, Fed stance and Nvidia governance fixes matter; in the midterm, cloud‑provider capital‑spend returns will determine the outcome. After this round of market cleaning, only the most committed and financially savvy investors will remain.

美國11月消費者信心指數升至去年1月以來高位，激勵美元上漲，並據三位知情人士週二稱，美國貿易代表辦公室(USTR)準備公布調查，聚焦包括中國和歐盟在內十六個主要貿易夥伴涉嫌存在工業產能過剩，預計對廣泛商品徵收新進口關稅，新一輪關稅威脅打擊市場情緒，而且人工智能(AI)相關科技股帶動的股市反彈偃旗息鼓，引發亞洲股市重挫，增添美元的避險買盤，但日本央行(BOJ)數據顯示，10月追蹤企業間服務交易價格的服務業生產者物價指數(PPI)較上年同期上揚4.2%，創1990年來最快增速，表明通貨膨脹壓力擴大，進一步強化BOJ近期加息的理由，而且TBS電視台報導，日本政府目前不考慮為本財政年補充預算發行新赤字融資債券，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓於159.50高點備受壓力。

隨後美國數據顯示，當周初請失業金人數降至18.9萬，10月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數則分別較前月與去年同期漲0.3%及3.8%，通貨膨脹再升溫強化美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)可能持續升息至明年初的預期，另外10月新屋銷售較前月升14.2%至年率創去年12月以來最高70.1萬戶，而且第三季國內生產總值(GDP)增速上修至三年最快達4.3%，並據FED最新褐皮書表示，經濟以輕微至溫和速度增長，但投入成本漲幅超過銷售價格漲幅，企業利潤面臨愈來愈大壓力，而且美元受與AI交易相關的資本流動和經濟增長預期影響，兌日圓下挫至158.64低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於159.30-50，支撐於158.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

昨日澳洲統計局數據顯示，國際油價上漲推動燃料價格躍升，促使10月消費者物價指數(CPI)分別較前月與上年同期漲0.5%及4.9%，而且剔除燃料成本影響，反映核心通貨膨脹的CPI截尾均值較去年同期升3.8%，結束前數月持穩3.6%的走勢，通貨膨脹壓力普遍存在，令澳洲央行(RBA)明年降息的預期降溫，激勵澳幣小漲，但亞洲股市重挫衝擊風險偏好，而且銅價觸及逾十一個月低位，限制澳幣漲勢，拖累歐元兌美元至1.0930低點。
隨著美國新關稅威脅引發避險情緒，並據德國表示，9月出口與零售業營業額弱於最初估計，第三季GDP較前季增長0.1%低於初值，但法國11月消費者信心指數如預期升至82，而且十年期美國公債與德國公債收益率差收窄，在週四美國感恩節假期前，提振歐元兌美元至1.0992高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.0930-50，阻力於1.1020-40。
◆GBP/USD

由輝達帶動的股市反彈行情僅曇花一現，週三市場再瀰漫避險情緒，並在美國公布關鍵通貨膨脹數據及感恩節假期前，投資人減持風險資產頭寸，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3043低點。隨後英國央行(BOE)總裁貝利稱，若能源價格穩定，通貨膨脹峰值可能更低，但傾向進一步加息，同時BOE貨幣政策委員會(MPC)委員曼恩呼籲更大幅度、更早升息，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3131高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3075-95，阻力於1.3170-90。
